We are seeking a dynamic Business Manager / Supervisor to lead and grow our Modern Trade and Retail channels across the Philippines. This role is pivotal in driving market share and brand penetration within the coatings and building materials retail sector. * Lead the retail sales team to achieve revenue and collection targets nationwide.

* Act as Key Account Manager (KAM) for top retail groups (SM, Robinsons, Puregold, Mercury Drug), handling framework agreements, promotions, and display fee negotiations.

* Collaborate with Marketing to execute in-store promotions, “Perfect Store” initiatives, and planogram standards.

* Coach and motivate frontline sales representatives and merchandisers; conduct regular business reviews.

* Travel frequently between Metro Manila and key cities (Cebu, Davao) and represent the company at exhibitions (e.g., WORLDBEX).

Job Qualifications



* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or related field.

* Proven track record in key account development or store roll-outs with major retailers (SM, Robinsons, Wilcon).

* Fluent in English and Tagalog; Mandarin proficiency is a plus.

* Excellent negotiation skills, resilience under pressure, and a results-driven mindset.

* Strong leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills.

* Willingness to travel extensively; must have own transportation for store audits in Metro Manila.



Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to take ownership of a fast-growing retail channel, gain international training exposure, and enjoy competitive incentives while working with a leading brand in the building materials industry.

title: Campaign Launcher (Meta) — Night Shift
description:
Company: OLVA Brands — e-commerce group running 4 active stores (DK, AUS, UK + new launch) 

Type: Full-time, remote, Mon–Sat Shift (non-negotiable): 22:00 – 04:00 PHP time 

Reports to: Senior Media Buyer · works daily alongside the Junior Media Buyer



About us

We run direct-response e-commerce across four markets with ~$12,000/day in Meta ad spend. Small team, fast decisions, no corporate layers. We're growing quickly and we build people up — juniors here move into buyer and lead roles when they earn it.



The role

You are the hands on the ad accounts during our launch window. Every day there is a batch of new creatives and campaigns waiting to go live. Your job is to get them live — correctly, fast, and without errors — across four stores.



This is an execution role, not a strategy role. Strategy comes from the Senior Media Buyer. You own speed and accuracy.



What you'll do

Launch new campaigns, ad sets and ads across 4 Meta BM ad accounts during your shift

Pull creatives and copy from our system and match them to the correct product, market and funnel

Follow naming conventions exactly — no exceptions, our reporting depends on it

Check every launch: correct landing page, correct pixel, correct market, correct budget

Flag rejected or restricted ads immediately and log them for recovery

Report at the end of every shift: what launched, what failed, what needs attention



Requirements

Proven hands-on experience in Meta Ads Manager (this is not an entry-level role — you have launched real campaigns with real budget)

Able to launch a full batch fast and accurately under time pressure

Understanding of campaign structure: CBO, ad sets, cost caps, budgets, placements

Familiar with ad rejections, restricted accounts and how to handle them

Strong English (written), reliable internet, own computer

Available 22:00 – 04:00 PHT, Monday to Saturday — permanently. If you cannot commit to night shifts long term, do not apply.



Nice to have:

Experience with dropshipping or direct-response e-commerce

Experience across multiple markets/currencies

Experience with Airtable, Google Sheets, Slack



What we offer

Long-term position in a fast-growing company

Real path to Junior Media Buyer and beyond

Performance bonus structure on top of base pay

Flat team, direct communication, no bureaucracy

title: Senior AI Graphic Designer & Social Media Lead
description:
We are looking for a highly creative and exceptionally talented AI Graphic Designer for a full-time [remote / in-office] position.



The ideal candidate is an art director at heart who breathes design and digital media. We need an expert who will take the reins, lead our company's visual language, and produce breathtaking assets across all our social media platforms: Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn,
, and YouTube.



Responsibilities



Lead the Visual Identity: Develop, elevate, and maintain the company's brand identity at the absolute highest standard across all digital channels.



Premium Social Media Design: Create scroll-stopping posts, stories, carousels, YouTube thumbnails, and premium advertising creatives for paid campaigns.



Advanced AI Integration: Write complex prompts, generate high-quality scenes/objects, and seamlessly blend AI-generated assets (images, textures, vectors) into professional graphic designs.



Platform Adaptation: Utilize a deep understanding of audience behavior, aspect ratios, formats, and current trends to adapt creatives perfectly for each specific platform.



End-to-End Execution: Manage the entire creative process—from brainstorming and conceptualization to the final pixel-perfect design and export.



Requirements



At least 4+ years of professional graphic design experience, with a strong focus on social media, digital marketing, and branding.



Proven, hands-on experience using advanced AI image-generation tools (e.g., Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E 3, Adobe Firefly).



Absolute mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud, specifically Photoshop and Illustrator. (Knowledge of After Effects or basic video editing is a massive plus).



A phenomenal eye for typography, composition, color theory, and an uncompromising, pixel-perfect attention to detail.



Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and lead design projects from scratch in a fast-paced environment.



Please note: To be considered for this position, you must submit your portfolio beforehand.

title: Amazon PPC & Operations Specialist (We Train You) - Long-Term, Growth to Manager
description:
IMPORTANT: Start your application message with the word SPIKE. Applications that don't start with SPIKE will not be read.



Hi, I'm Ori. I run a 6-year-old Amazon US brand in the sports niche, with bestselling products and steady growth. I'm hiring my first full-time team member. (You'll learn the brand name at the interview stage - standard caution in the Amazon world.)



I'm not hiring you for a task. I'm hiring a full-time person to help me expand my business. You will START with Amazon PPC (advertising) - but if that's as far as you want to go, this isn't the job for you. I'm looking for someone who wants to grow into a manager role as we build the team. I will train you personally.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (STARTING POSITION):

- Analyze Amazon search term reports and manage negative keywords

- Adjust bids inside clear rules we set together

- Keep our campaigns clean and organized

- Build a weekly performance summary



AS YOU GROW: inventory, purchase orders and shipment tracking - and later, managing people and projects as we build the team.



You do NOT need Amazon experience. I will teach you everything. What I can't teach is who you are - so this is what I need from you:

- You are truly ANALYTICAL. You enjoy numbers, spreadsheets, and finding the "why" behind data. Parts of this work are detailed and repetitive - you have to genuinely like that kind of work.

- You already work with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) and want to use them more. Our company runs on AI systems, and working WITH them is part of this job.

- Strong Google Sheets / Excel skills

- Excellent written English

- You learn fast, ask questions, and tell me honestly when you don't know something

- Reliable internet + backup plan, own computer



SCHEDULE: Full-time (40 hrs/week). Your working hours must overlap with Israel mornings (we'll agree on exact hours).



PAY: $800-$900/month, paid reliably in USD, plus health and internet stipends, paid leave, and yearly raises tied to your growth. When you grow into management, the raise is significant.



HOW TO APPLY: Send a message starting with the word SPIKE, plus 2-5 sentences on why I should hire you instead of anyone else. Those who follow these two instructions get our short application form. Then: a PAID test task (2-4 hours, paid whether or not you continue) - then a video interview - then an offer with a 90-day test period that works both ways: I check this is right for you, you check I'm right for you.



This is a long-term role. I'm building a company, and the first person in gets the biggest opportunity to grow with it.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About the Role:



We are a fast-growing D2C brand in the health and wellness space. We sell physical information products — primarily premium hardcover books — to a large and loyal customer base, and we are expanding into new product formats and conditions. Our products have already reached over a million homes worldwide.



The goal is to help 100 million people get healthier at home — and that requires products that are not just good, but genuinely exceptional. Design is a core part of how we get there.



This is not a role where you make things look nice. This is a role where you make products that change how people engage with their health — products so well-designed that they are easy to use, hard to put down, and impossible to ignore on a shelf. We want Apple-level intentionality applied to every page, every layout, every cover, every touchpoint. Design that solves the customer's problem AND sells — not design that is beautiful but impractical.



Our customers are primarily women aged 50 and older. They are not designers. They are not tech-savvy. They need information presented in a way that feels welcoming, credible, and effortless to use. If the design is cluttered, intimidating, or confusing — it does not matter how good the content is. They will not use it. Your job is to make sure they use it.



Why this role exists now:



We have built a strong product team and a content pipeline that is producing genuinely helpful health resources. But the design quality has not kept pace with the ambition. Our current products look good — but they do not look world-class. To reach 100 million people, the product has to be something people love holding, love using, and want to show their friends. That requires a designer who breathes this, who obsesses over every detail, and who understands that great design for this audience means clarity, warmth, and practical beauty — not trendy minimalism or flashy aesthetics that do not serve the user.



What You Will Own:

• The visual and experiential design of all physical products — setting and enforcing a design standard that is genuinely world-class. Every book, every page, every cover, every insert should feel like it was made by a company that cares deeply about the person holding it.

• Product usability and information design — making dense health information accessible, scannable, and actionable for an older demographic. This means smart use of typography, hierarchy, illustration, color, and layout to guide people through content without overwhelming them. You understand that design is not decoration — it is communication.

• Design system and brand visual language — building a cohesive design system across our product line so that every new product feels like it belongs to the same family. As we expand into new health conditions and product formats, visual consistency and quality need to scale with us.

• Cover and packaging design — the first impression matters enormously in our business. You own the visual impact of our products from the moment a customer sees an ad to the moment they open the package. Covers need to feel premium, trustworthy, and compelling.

• Illustration and visual asset direction — whether working with illustrators, AI tools, or producing assets yourself, you ensure that every visual element in the product serves a purpose. Illustrations should educate, not just decorate. Diagrams should clarify, not confuse.

• Collaboration with the content team — working closely with writers and researchers to ensure that the content and design evolve together, not in isolation. You push back when content is not structured in a way that supports good design, and you adapt your design when the content demands it.

• Creative input on new product formats — as we explore digital companions, apps, and new physical formats beyond books, you bring a design perspective to what these products should feel and look like. You think about the full customer experience, not just the page.

• Raising the standard of the entire team — you are the person who sets the bar. Junior designers, editors, and contractors look to your work and your feedback to understand what "great" looks like here. You mentor, review, and elevate.



You Are the Right Fit If:

• You have a portfolio that demonstrates genuinely exceptional design work for physical or information products — books, magazines, packaging, editorial, or consumer products. We want to see work that makes us stop and look twice.

• You deeply understand information design and typography. You know how to take complex content and make it feel simple, inviting, and easy to follow. You have designed for audiences who are not young, not tech-native, and not design-literate — and you made it work beautifully.

• You obsess over details — spacing, alignment, color relationships, paper texture, print quality. You care about things most people would not notice, because you know that the sum of those details is what separates a good product from one people love.

• You understand that design must serve the customer's problem, not the designer's ego. You can explain why every design choice helps the person use the product better, trust the information more, or take action more easily. Beautiful but impractical does not interest you.

• You have experience designing for print production — you understand CMYK, bleed, binding constraints, paper weight, and how design translates from screen to physical product. You have shipped real physical products and dealt with the constraints that come with manufacturing.

• You are versatile across illustration, layout, typography, and brand design. You may not be the world's best illustrator, but you can direct illustration work, produce strong visual assets, and integrate diverse visual elements into a cohesive product.

• You are comfortable with AI design tools and eager to push them further. We are an AI-forward company and expect senior team members to leverage these tools to move faster and explore more possibilities — while maintaining the quality bar.

• You are a self-directed creative who thrives with high autonomy. You do not need to be told what good looks like — you already know, and you push the team toward it.



Nice to Have:

• Experience designing for health, wellness, or educational content — you understand the balance between credibility and accessibility.

• Background in editorial design, publishing, or information-dense product design at scale.

• Experience designing for an older demographic (50+) — you understand readability, visual hierarchy, and trust signals that matter to this audience.

• Illustration skills — hand-drawn, digital, or AI-assisted — that can add warmth and clarity to health content.

• Experience with packaging design and unboxing experiences for physical consumer products.

• Familiarity with design for digital products (apps, interactive guides) in addition to physical — as we expand into these formats.

• Experience building and maintaining design systems across a growing product line.



What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:

• You complete a thorough audit of our current product design — books, covers, packaging, digital assets — and present a clear, honest assessment of where we are versus where we need to be, with a prioritized roadmap for getting there.

• The next product release shows a visible step-change in design quality — not a total overhaul, but a clear signal that the standard has been raised. People inside the company and customers should notice the difference.

• You have established a strong working relationship with the content team — design and content are being developed together rather than design being applied after the fact.

• A coherent design system is taking shape — foundational decisions about typography, color, illustration style, and layout patterns that will scale across future products.

• You have identified where AI tools, new processes, or additional resources can accelerate design quality and output — and progress is underway on at least one of these.

• The product team and leadership feel the impact — there is a new level of design thinking and intentionality in how we approach every product decision.



To Apply:



Please submit your application at zurl.to/Ts9o?source=CareerSite and include the following:

1. Your portfolio — we want to see physical or information product design work that demonstrates exceptional craft and intentionality. Show us your best work and tell us why it worked.

2. How you approach designing for a non-technical, older audience — what principles guide you when the user is not a designer.

3. An example of a product where your design directly improved usability or customer outcomes — not just aesthetics.

4. How you think about balancing beauty with practicality in information-dense products.

5. Compensation expectations.

title: Graphic Designer for DTC Brands Facebook Static Ads
description:
Graphic Designer – Static Ads for D2C E-Commerce Brands



Posted on OnlineJobs.ph. Full time, 40 hrs/week, $1,200/month+ based on

experience. This file is the exact text in the live post: keep it in sync if

the post is edited.



The application itself lives at pages/apply/design.tsx. Anything about hours,

pay, or the exercise that changes here has to change there too, because

candidates read both.



---



We're a marketing agency looking for a graphic designer who lives and breathes

static ad creative for direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands.



What you'll do:

- Design static ad creatives for Meta 
/Instagram)

- Produce high volume creative batches: image ads, product-on-background

  layouts, before/afters, testimonial and review cards, UGC-style graphics,

  listicles, comparison charts, offer/promo graphics

- Build variations of winning ads for testing (new hooks, headlines, colors,

  crops, formats)

- Resize and adapt each concept into 4:5, 9:16 and other required ad sizes

- Do basic photo retouching, background removal and product compositing

- Work inside brand guidelines for multiple clients and keep files organized

- Collaborate with media buyers and copywriters, and iterate based on ad

  performance data



The volume, so nobody is surprised later: about 75 statics a week, roughly 15

on a normal day, shaped as 5 concepts x 3 variants. That works because variants

come off a proven concept and because you will have templates and organized

brand assets, not because you are inventing 75 original ideas from nothing. But

it is a production-heavy role. If you need a week per concept, this is not your

job, and there is nothing wrong with that.



What we're looking for:

- 3+ years of graphic design experience, with a portfolio that clearly shows

  static ad work for e-commerce/D2C brands (please include a link)

- Strong command of Figma

- Solid typography, layout, hierarchy and color skills; you know how to make an

  ad readable on a small phone screen

- Understanding of direct response principles: hooks, benefits, social proof,

  clear CTAs

- Fast turnaround without sacrificing quality; comfortable producing many

  concepts per week

- Excellent written English and clear, proactive communication

- Reliable internet and your own computer

- You can be online 8am to 12pm Eastern every working day. That block is fixed,

  because it is when the buyers are working. The rest of your hours are yours

  to arrange. If you are in the Philippines that core lands roughly 8pm to

  midnight your time, so go in with your eyes open.

- You are comfortable with AI image tools and honest about using them. They are

  allowed here. Hiding them is not.



Nice to have:

- Experience with simple motion/GIF versions of static ads

- Experience designing landing page sections or
 graphics

- Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager creative specs



What we offer:

- $1,200/month floor. That is a floor, not a ceiling, and there is real

  headroom for a strong independent contributor who needs very little

  management.

- Paid through Deel on the first of each month

- Employee or contractor, whichever you prefer. We hire directly.

- 13th-month pay, paid Philippine holidays, and 7 days of flexible leave

- A Claude subscription and AI-first workflows

- Direct daily feedback from the people spending the money, so you learn what

  actually wins instead of guessing





TO APPLY



Apply here, and only here:







Please do not apply through OnlineJobs.ph. Do not send a message, a resume, or

a portfolio link through this platform. We do not read them. They are not

sorted later and not reviewed in a batch. The link above is the only channel,

and anything that arrives another way is missed, not deprioritized.



The application is a single page and takes about 45 minutes. It includes a real

design exercise: you will critique four live static ads, rank them, and rebuild

the one you rank weakest. You source the assets yourself and you may generate

images with AI, so do not worry about matching the original artwork exactly. We

are reading your thinking and your craft. Do not start it until you have an

uninterrupted block, because it is not something you can do in pieces.



Finalists get a paid project interview: roughly a couple of hours of real work,

paid $100, before any hire decision. We do not ask for free work, and we do not

hire off a portfolio alone.

title: Amazon PPC Manager
description:
As a growing Amazon agency in Europe, we are seeking a skilled and experienced Amazon PPC Advertising Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and optimizing PPC campaigns for several Amazon accounts, driving sales growth and maximizing ROI. We are definitely looking for a long-term hire!



This isn't just a job; it's a dream come true for anyone passionate about online marketing, offering attractive pay, boundless growth potential, and a platform to showcase your exceptional talent. Your contributions will directly impact our growth, and your efforts will be recognized and rewarded.

Plus, you'll collaborate with a team of bright, motivated individuals, all dedicated to revolutionizing the Amazon market.



We value experience, but even more so, we're looking for someone with a sharp intellect, a solid work ethic, and an eagerness to learn and innovate.



Key Responsibilities:



- Develop and manage PPC strategies for various Amazon accounts.

- Conduct thorough keyword research and analysis to optimize ad campaigns.

- Monitor and adjust bids, budgets, and performance metrics to achieve desired targets.

- Analyze campaign performance data to identify trends and insights for continuous improvement.

- Collaborate with the team to integrate PPC strategies with overall marketing goals.

- Stay up-to-date with Amazon's advertising policies and industry best practices.

- Prepare special deals like Prime days, Black Fridays,...

- Onboard new clients and tailor a custom strategy for each one

- You will be in charge of at least 10 Amazon Accounts, where each Account has between 5-100 products. --> So only apply if you have handled such amount of accounts and products before!

- You know how to take an Amazon Account from 50k revenue per month to 150k. 

- Your performance will be directly measured by our clients' results. So make sure you know what you are doing ;)



Qualifications:

- Proven experience in managing Amazon PPC campaigns with demonstrable success.

- You worked for an Amazon agency before as an PPC Manager

- 3 years of experience in PPC is a MUST!

- Advanced understanding of Amazon's advertising platform and PPC best practices.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills in English

- Detail-oriented with strong organizational and project management abilities.

- Proficiency in relevant tools and software (Helium 10; Data Dive,...)



Why Join Us:

- Be part of a dynamic and growing team. We have multiple VA's working for us from the PH.

- We value you and your personal growth.

- Opportunity to work on diverse projects with significant impact.

- Competitive salary and benefits.

- A supportive and collaborative work environment.

- Full-Remote

- We are definitely looking for a long-term hire!





Application Process:



Send us a one-page letter telling us why you would be a good fit for this job.

Interested candidates should submit a resume, cover letter, and examples of previous successful Amazon work.

Include "Amazon PPC Manager" in the headline of your response.

Great jobs like this come along once in a lifetime. Don’t let this one slip by.





Only apply if you are a real Amazon expert. No newbies on this job.

40h / week. No part time or freelancers.



Can't wait to see your application and hopefully work together!

title: GoHighLevel + AI Studio Fulfilment VA Needed ASAP
description:
I run AI Services Essex, a UK-based business helping service-based businesses with smart websites, GoHighLevel systems, AI automation, review systems, chatbots, WhatsApp/social media automation and Voice AI receptionists.



I am looking for an experienced GoHighLevel + AI Studio fulfilment VA who is available now.



This is not a general admin role.



I need someone who can take client projects from onboarding through to completion, work from SOPs and onboarding forms, set things up properly, test the work, provide clear updates, and support client onboarding or handover calls where needed.



Some projects are smaller website, CRM, review and missed-call text-back setups. Other projects are more technical and may include AI chatbots, Voice AI, WhatsApp-connected chatbots, social media channel messaging,
 notifications, routing, escalation workflows, appointment booking and database reactivation.



## Important



You must already have hands-on GoHighLevel experience and hands-on AI Studio experience.



Please do not apply if you are only willing to learn AI Studio. I need someone who is already familiar and confident working inside AI Studio website builds.



## Main Responsibilities



The work may include:



* GoHighLevel sub-account setup

* AI Studio website builds

* cloning and customising existing website templates

* updating websites from client onboarding forms

* creating service pages and location pages

* setting up navigation and dropdowns

* building About / Why Choose Us sections

* contact forms and smart forms

* lead notifications

* CRM setup

* pipeline / opportunities setup

* appointment booking / calendar setup

* missed-call text-back setup

* review request automation

* review management setup

* automated review responses

* database reactivation campaigns

* legacy client review campaigns

* domain connection

* Google Business Profile connection where required

* UK phone number / regulatory bundle setup

* mobile checking

* testing and QA before client preview or handover

* joining client setup, onboarding or handover calls where needed



## Chatbot / AI Experience Needed



I am particularly interested in someone who has experience with AI chatbot and Voice AI setups.



Chatbot work may include:



* website chatbot setup

* WhatsApp-connected chatbot setup

* chatbot setup for social media channels where required

* AI chatbot knowledge base setup using client services, locations, FAQs and business information

* connecting chatbot conversations to GoHighLevel CRM

* capturing lead details from chatbot conversations

* setting up internal notifications from chatbot enquiries

* setting up
 notifications from chatbot enquiries

* routing enquiries to the correct person, team or department

* multiple escalation levels

* callback or follow-up task creation

* testing different customer scenarios before launch

* checking that the chatbot gives accurate answers

* checking that the chatbot escalates properly when required



## Voice AI Experience Needed



Voice AI work may include:



* Voice AI receptionist setup

* prompt setup and optimisation

* knowledge base setup

* call testing

* call routing or escalation where required

* call summary setup

* internal notification setup

* QA and optimisation before handover



## Missed-Call Text-Back Experience



Missed-call text-back is a separate feature from Voice AI, but may be part of the wider client call-handling setup.



This work may include:



* setting up missed-call text-back

* connecting missed calls to GoHighLevel CRM

* triggering SMS follow-up after missed calls

* creating notifications or tasks from missed-call enquiries

* testing that the missed-call text-back works correctly before launch



## The Right Person Must Be



* technically strong

* detail-focused

* reliable with deadlines

* excellent in written and spoken English

* consistent with communication

* responsive during agreed UK working-hour overlap times

* able to provide progress updates without being chased

* able to follow SOPs carefully

* able to read onboarding forms properly before starting

* confident enough to work independently

* careful enough to ask good questions when something is genuinely unclear

* able to check their own work before sending it back

* comfortable working with UK clients and UK time zone deadlines

* comfortable being involved in client onboarding and handover calls



I do not need someone who guesses on important technical setup or needs constant handholding. I need someone with enough GoHighLevel, AI Studio, chatbot and automation experience to own the fulfilment process properly.



Reliability and communication are very important. Please do not apply if you cannot respond consistently, provide updates, or communicate during agreed UK overlap times when live client projects are underway.



## Working Style



This is currently project-based or part-time support.



Hours will vary depending on client workload. Some weeks may be busier than others depending on client approvals, access, onboarding calls and feedback.



Most build work can be done in your own working hours, but I need reliable communication during agreed UK overlap times when active client projects are underway.



Work will usually be paid either:



* per project, with the project fee agreed before work starts, or

* hourly with a capped project budget agreed upfront



I do not want open-ended hours without prior agreement.



Any additional work outside the agreed scope must be discussed and approved before being carried out.



There is potential for this to become more regular as more client projects come in.



## Budget



My current technical VA baseline has been around $10/hour, so I am looking for someone broadly in that range.



Please do not apply if your rate is significantly higher than this, as it will not be the right fit at this stage.



## To Apply



Please answer these questions:



1. How many years of GoHighLevel experience do you have?

2. Have you used AI Studio before? Please describe what you have built.

3. Can you confidently build or customise websites inside AI Studio?

4. Have you set up missed-call text-back before?

5. Have you set up review request automations before?

6. Have you built AI chatbots that answer customer questions?

7. Have you worked with website chatbots before?

8. Have you worked with WhatsApp-connected chatbots before?

9. Have you worked with chatbots connected to social media channels?

10. Have you connected chatbot enquiries to GoHighLevel CRM, workflows, notifications or
 alerts?

11. Have you built chatbot routing, escalation levels, callback tasks or follow-up tasks before?

12. Have you set up Voice AI before?

13. Have you tested and optimised Voice AI before client handover?

14. Have you connected domains before?

15. Have you worked with UK phone numbers or regulatory bundle setup before?

16. Are you comfortable joining client onboarding or handover calls?

17. Have you worked with UK clients before?

18. Are you available to start immediately?

19. What hours can you work in UK time?

20. What is your hourly rate or preferred project rate?

21. Please send examples of relevant GoHighLevel, AI Studio, website, chatbot, automation or Voice AI work.

22. Please send a 2-minute video explaining why you are a good fit for this role.



The video is essential because excellent spoken English is required for this role, including possible client-facing calls.



Applications without a short video will not be considered.



I am looking to interview suitable candidates as soon as possible.

title: Executive Assistant / Administrative Project Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a highly capable Virtual Executive Assistant / Administrative Project Coordinator to provide administrative and project management support and help keep priorities, communications, projects, and internal workflows moving efficiently.

This is not an accounting role.



The primary need is for someone who is excellent at administration and project coordination—someone who can bring organization to multiple moving pieces, maintain visibility across priorities, follow up consistently, and reduce the amount of operational work that currently requires direct involvement.



The ideal candidate will be proactive, highly organized, detail-oriented, an excellent communicator, and comfortable taking ownership of administrative workflows rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

Experience working in an accounting firm, CPA firm, or similar professional services environment is highly preferred.

Schedule: Approximately 30 hours per week to start, with the potential to grow to 40 hours per week as the role and responsibilities expand.





Key Responsibilities:

* Administrative & Project Management Support

* Maintain organized task and project trackers

* Keep project statuses, deadlines, responsibilities, and next steps current

* Monitor outstanding tasks and proactively follow up with the appropriate individuals

* Help coordinate multiple active projects and client engagements

* Identify items that are stalled, overdue, or awaiting action

* Create structure and visibility so priorities do not fall through the cracks

* Help ensure projects continue moving without requiring constant oversight 



Daily Priority Management:

* Prepare concise daily summaries of priorities and outstanding items

* Highlight matters requirin, input, or decision

* Surface important deadlines, client needs, and follow-ups

* Help distinguish high-priority items from routine administrative matters

* Maintain an organized view of what needs to happen next



 Management & Triage:

* Assist with managing and organizing incoming

* Separate important communications from routine messages and noise

* Flag
s requiring personal attention or response

* Draft routine correspondence where appropriate

* Manage scheduling-related communications

* Send follow-ups and reminders

* Help maintain an organized and responsive communication flow



Client & Scheduling Coordination:

* Coordinate meetings and scheduling

* Send routine client follow-ups

* Send reminders for outstanding documents and information

* Track pending client requests

* Help ensure clients receive timely and professional communication

* Maintain visibility into outstanding administrative items associated with client engagements



Team & Work Coordination:

* Help organize and package assignments for internal staff

* Ensure team members have the information and direction needed to move work forward

* Communicate assignments and next steps clearly

* Track delegated items and follow up on completion

* Help reduce situations where staff are waiting to provide routine direction or assignments

* Keep communication and workflow organized across the team



Systems, Processes & Special Projects:

* Assist with administrative systems and workflow improvement projects

* Help organize and document repeatable internal processes

* Support implementation or configuration of business tools as needed

* Assist with operational projects such as phone systems, internal workflows, and administrative technology

* Identify opportunities to simplify or improve recurring administrative processes



The successful candidate does not need to already know every platform the firm uses. The ability to learn new systems quickly, think through processes, and confidently manage projects is more important than experience with any specific software.



Ideal Candidate:

* Has strong administrative and project management experience

* Is exceptionally organized and detail-oriented

* Can manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously

* Takes initiative without requiring constant direction

* Is comfortable taking ownership of tasks from beginning to completion

* Follows up consistently and professionally

* Thinks ahead and anticipates what needs to happen next

* Communicates exceptionally well in both written and spoken English

* Is comfortable interacting professionally with clients and internal staff

* Can create structure in environments with many moving pieces

* Is dependable, responsive, and accountable

* Learns new systems and technology quickly

* Can work independently while keeping leadership appropriately informed

* Is interested in becoming a long-term, trusted member of the firm's support team



Experience & Qualifications:

Strongly Preferred..

* Prior experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, or similar role

* Demonstrated experience managing administrative projects, deadlines, follow-ups, and multiple stakeholders

* Experience supporting a business owner, partner, executive, or senior professional

* Strong professional written and verbal communication skills

* Experience working independently in a remote environment



Highly Desirable

Experience within a..

* CPA or accounting firm

* Financial services organization

* Law firm

* Consulting firm

* Professional services organization

Prior experience in an accounting or CPA firm would be particularly valuable because the candidate will already understand the importance of deadlines, client responsiveness, documentation, confidentiality, and managing multiple concurrent engagements.



Nice to Have — Not Required

* Clockify

* QuickBooks

* Project management platforms

* CRM systems

* Microsoft Office

* Google Workspace

* Workflow or process documentation tools

Specific software experience is secondary to the candidate's ability to organize, manage projects, communicate effectively, and learn new systems quickly.





Confidentiality & Data Security

Because we are working with sensitive financial information, forensic accounting matters, business valuations, tax and audit work, and litigation-related engagements, confidentiality and discretion are critical components of this position.



The successful candidate must demonstrate:

* Exceptional discretion and professionalism

* Responsible handling of sensitive and confidential information

* Secure remote-work practices

* Careful management of client documents and communications

title: E-Mail Marketing Strategist (Klaviyo) | Account Analysis, Roadmap & Lifecycle Strategy
description:
Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled freelance Klaviyo specialist with a strong background in e-mail marketing for e-commerce brands.

You will act as our strategic
 marketing advisor — analyzing client accounts, identifying the highest-impact opportunities, and giving us a clear prioritization of what to build/send, fix, or improve.

define a systematic test roadmap with clear prioritization and expected revenue impact

Contribute strategic input beyond pure execution

You've moved beyond execution — you've advised clients on
 strategy, developed prioritization frameworks, and defined what to build rather than just building it

Deep understanding of customer segmentation, clustering logic, and lifecycle marketing

Strong analytical mindset with hands-on experience in LTV/CLV analysis and optimization

Ability to translate data into structured hypotheses and actionable flow strategies

Experience building segment-specific flow architectures for e-commerce brands

Familiarity with ClickUp or willingness to work with it

Reliable, structured working style with proactive communication



To apply, please include:

Walk us through a client account you audited: what did you find, what did you prioritize, and why?

A short description of your analytical approach: how do you move from customer data ? segmentation ? flow architecture ? measurable outcome?

How do you typically structure your first 30 days with a new e-commerce client?

Your weekly availability

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Daily Beauty & Color Analysis Reels
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



Palette Hunt is the second-largest color analysis website in the world. We are looking for a short-form video editor to help us publish one high-quality Instagram Reel per day.



The videos will analyze celebrities' color seasons, clothing colors, and beauty choices. The visual storytelling will be inspired by QOVES Studio, adapted into concise 30-60 second vertical videos.



We will provide an AI-assisted production pack containing:

- Script and voiceover

- Video structure and shot list

- Color palette and recommendations

- On-screen text

- Editing direction



Your role is to source suitable celebrity photos or clips and turn these materials into an engaging finished video.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Edit 30 vertical videos per month

- Deliver approximately 5-7 completed videos each week

- Find clear, high-quality celebrity photos or clips

- Add captions, color swatches, comparisons, and light motion graphics

- Match the visuals closely to the script and voiceover

- Maintain a consistent branded editing style

- Export videos in 1080 x 1920 format

- Complete one revision when necessary



Videos can be produced in weekly batches. You do not need to work every day.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Strong visual taste, particularly in beauty, fashion, or lifestyle content

- Experience editing Instagram Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts

- Good written English and attention to detail

- Comfortable following detailed creative briefs

- Able to select flattering and relevant celebrity images

- Reliable with weekly deadlines

- Comfortable using AI-assisted workflows



CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve are all acceptable.



Color-analysis experience is helpful but not required. A genuine interest in beauty, personal styling, makeup, or fashion is more important.



COMPENSATION



The starting compensation is $180-$250 USD per month for 30 completed videos, depending on experience, portfolio quality, and editing ability.



Shortlisted applicants will complete one $5 paid test video before we select the editor.



This can become a stable, long-term position. Compensation can increase as the channel grows and you demonstrate excellent quality and reliability.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:

1. A link to your three best short-form videos

2. The editing software you use

3. Your experience with beauty, fashion, or educational content

4. How long you expect one 30-60 second video to take when the script, voiceover, and editing brief are provided

5. The words "Color Reel" at the beginning of your application



Please do not send a generic application. We will prioritize editors whose portfolios demonstrate strong pacing, typography, and visual judgment.

The existing channel is provided only to show that we have already started creating videos. Please do not copy the older topics or production style.



I am hiring someone to help Smartzilla consistently produce better and more useful videos specifically for law firms.



The new videos do not need expensive production or advanced animation. They should feel natural, professional, practical, and easy for law firm owners to understand.



PAY, SCHEDULE, AND ROOM TO GROW:



Starting pay is $25 per completed 3 to 5-minute video.



Approximately two videos will be assigned each week. This equals approximately $50 per week or $200 for eight completed videos.



The rate includes:



• English narration using your real voice

• Screen recording

• Basic video editing

• Readable captions

• One minor revision



We will begin with a four-video trial at $25 per completed video. If I really like your demo and the quality of your work, this can become consistent, long-term work at approximately two videos per week.



Please understand that the starting rate will remain $25 per video while we work on growing the channel. If the channel begins generating revenue and your work contributes to its growth, I would be happy to increase your pay per video down the road.



I am looking for someone who wants to grow with Smartzilla, but I also want to be transparent that any pay increase will depend on the channel’s performance and will not happen immediately.



SHORT VIDEO DEMO REQUIRED:



Please send an actual finished screen-recording demo lasting no more than 60 seconds.



The demo should be a short example of the same type of video you would create for Smartzilla.



YOUR DEMO MUST INCLUDE:



• Your real voice explaining the topic in English

• An actual recording of your computer screen

• A demonstration of you using ChatGPT

• Basic editing with clean cuts

• Readable captions

• At least one zoom or highlight showing something important



DEMO TOPIC:



“Does ChatGPT Recommend Your Law Firm? Here’s How to Check”



WHAT TO DO IN THE DEMO:



1. Open ChatGPT on your computer.



2. Record your screen while asking:



“Can you recommend a personal injury lawyer in San Diego?”



3. Using your real voice, briefly explain that law firms can ask questions like this to begin checking which firms ChatGPT recommends.



4. Mention that changing the wording of the question may produce a different response.



5. Edit the screen recording and narration into one finished video lasting 60 seconds or less.



You may explain the topic naturally in your own words. You do not need advanced animation, stock footage, background music, or a fancy introduction.



Please use a clean browser window. Do not show personal bookmarks, private conversations, account information, or unrelated tabs.



Do not criticize or make claims about any law firm appearing in the response. The purpose is only to observe what ChatGPT displays.



PLEASE DO NOT SEND ONLY:



• An audio recording

• A written script

• An editing portfolio

• An unedited screen recording

• A video using an AI-generated voice



I need to see and hear a finished mini-example that combines your real voice, screen recording, captions, and basic editing.



The demo will only be used to evaluate your application. It will not be published or used commercially.



HOW TO APPLY:



Please include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself

2. Links to videos you have edited

3. The software you use for editing and screen recording

4. Confirmation that you are comfortable narrating with your real voice

5. Confirmation that you accept the starting rate of $25 per completed video

6. A link to your completed demo of 60 seconds or less



Begin your application with the phrase:



SMARTZILLA VIDEO



Applications without the requested finished demo will not be considered.

title: Outbound Appointment Setter / Business Development VA — Local Business Outreach (Austin, TX Market)
description:
We're a fast-growing Austin-based startup marketplace connecting local businesses with content creators. We need a sharp, personable Virtual Assistant to handle outbound outreach to local business owners via
 and social media (Instagram,
), book them onto short video calls with our team, and manage timely follow-up communication before and after those calls. This is not a copy-paste, mass-messaging role — every message needs to read like it was written by someone who actually looked at that specific business.



Responsibilities:



Research and identify local Austin-area businesses (restaurants, gyms, salons, retail, and similar categories) as outreach targets

Send personalized cold outreach via
 and social media DM (Instagram/Facebook) — no generic templates, no obvious mail-merge language

Book qualified businesses onto Google Meet calls with our founders using our scheduling tool

Send calendar confirmations and same-day SMS/email reminders to reduce no-shows

Follow up with businesses who attended a call but haven't yet completed our signup form

Track every contact, response, and outcome in our shared tracker (Google Sheets/Notion)

Report weekly on outreach volume, response rates, booked calls, show rate, and completed signups



Requirements:



Excellent written English is mandatory — near-native fluency, natural sentence structure, correct grammar. This role represents our brand directly to US business owners; broken or stilted English will lose the account.

Strong verbal English also preferred, in case any phone-based confirmation calls are needed

Demonstrated cold outreach or appointment-setting experience — SDR, lead generation, telemarketing, or virtual assistant experience specifically involving outbound prospecting

Proven ability to personalize outreach at scale — you will be asked in the interview to research a real business and write a cold message from scratch, live, with a time limit. Messages that read as generic, templated, or obviously AI-generated will not pass.

Comfortable using AI tools to assist research and drafting, but every message sent must be edited and personalized by you, not sent as raw AI output. We can tell the difference and it matters to us.

Experience with or willingness to learn: Google Sheets, Calendly, Notion, Instagram/Facebook messaging

Must be willing to work hours overlapping with US Central Time business hours (approximately 9am–5pm CT), which will require a shifted/night schedule in the Philippines

Self-motivated and comfortable with rejection — cold outreach has a high no/ignore rate and we need someone who doesn't lose energy or quality over repetition

Prior experience in real estate, marketing agency, or small business sales outreach is a strong plus



Compensation:



Base pay: $3/hour (negotiable based on experience), part-time

Bonus: $3-$5 for every booked meeting the business actually attends (no bonus for no-shows — this rewards quality booking and follow-through, not just calendar filling)

Milestone bonus: $50 for every 10 businesses who complete our waitlist signup as a result of your outreach



To Apply: Please do NOT send a generic application. In your application, include: (1) a short voice recording (even from your phone) introducing yourself in English, and (2) a sample cold outreach message you would send to a fictional local coffee shop called "Cosmic Grounds" inviting them to a quick call about a new marketing opportunity. Applications without both will not be reviewed.

title: Creator Affiliate Outreach & Onboarding Manager
description:
## About Us



We're a fast-growing DTC brand in the **couples and date-night space** — a premium physical product that's become a recurring obsession on TikTok and Instagram. Playful, a little spicy, and built to go viral.



We're scaling quickly, and our creator affiliate community is one of the biggest levers we have. The playbook is already proven in our exact niche — competitors have built affiliate armies pulling millions of organic views a month through networks of dedicated creator accounts.



We're building a better version, with better training, better creator economics and better systems.



---



## The Role



Our creator programme runs on two engines. The **Training Engine** turns creators into consistent, viral, revenue-generating machines. The **Outreach Engine** brings them in.



**You own the Outreach Engine.** Every creator who ever earns a commission with us will have entered through the pipeline you run.



That means:



- **Shortlisting** — sourcing and vetting creators against our ideal creator profile

- **Outreach** — running our message flows from first contact through follow-ups, objections and signed agreement

- **Onboarding** — taking every signed creator through to fully live and posting in our community

- **Optimisation** — this is the part that matters most. You're not just running the pipeline, you're making it better. Finding where conversion leaks, fixing that stage, and building the processes and tooling that compound month over month



All of the initial systems are already documented and ready on day one — the shortlisting checklist, the full message flows, the onboarding sequence, the pipeline tracker. You'll run them as written to start, then earn the data to improve them.



---



## Who We're Looking For



**Required:** previous creator, influencer or affiliate recruitment experience, and a DTC or e-commerce background.



Beyond that, you are:



- **Proactive by default** — you spot the problem and bring the fix, you don't wait to be assigned it

- **Relentlessly consistent** — this role carries real daily volume, and you hit it without being chased

- **Organised to a fault** — dozens of creators at different stages, none forgotten, nothing stalled silently

- **A warm, sharp communicator** — outreach that feels personal at volume

- **A systems thinker** — you see a leaky process and instinctively want to rebuild it, not just work harder

- **Built for a startup** — things move fast, priorities shift, and the answer isn't always written down yet. That excites you rather than unsettles you



---



## Why This One



We are hiring for where this role goes, not just where it starts.



The outreach engine won't be a one-person function forever. As the programme scales, this becomes a **department** — and the person who built it is first in line to lead it. Scope, seniority and package all step up as that happens; we don't wait for an annual cycle to recognise it.



We're early, we're growing fast, and the people who take genuine ownership of their area end up with far more of the business than they started with.



**If you want a fixed, unchanging task list, this isn't it. If you want to build something and own the result, apply.**



---



## The Details



- Full time, 40 hours per week

- Fully remote

- Long-term — we're hiring for years, not weeks

- Base + performance bonus package, shared with shortlisted candidates



---



## How to Apply



Please don't send a generic proposal — we read every application properly, and generic ones get archived immediately.



Answer these three:



1. Start your application with the word **SHORTLIST** so we know you've read this properly.

2. Tell us about a time you owned a process end to end and made it measurably better. What was the number before, what was it after, and what did you actually change?

3. What's your experience with creator, influencer or affiliate recruitment?

title: Video Editor for Long-Form Documentary Style ($35/video)
description:
Pay: $35 flat per video (gig-based) Video length: 20–45 minutes, depending on channel Type: Freelance/gig, with potential to grow into a long-term fixed role for the right editor



We're looking for an experienced video editor to work across three documentary-style YouTube channels, each in a different niche. This is long-form editing work, not short-form, social media, or UGC-style content. Pay is a flat $35 per video regardless of final length within our standard range.



This is what we expect you to be able to produce (made by other video editors in the team):

Niche 1 - video 1: 

Niche 1 - video 2: 

Niche 2 - video 1: 



This starts as a gig but can evolve into a steady, ongoing position — more videos, more consistent work — for editors who consistently deliver strong results.



What You'll Be Editing:

Three documentary-style channels, varying in niche and visual style, each 20–45 minutes per video. Some channels incorporate AI-generated imagery as part of the visual style (blended with the storytelling, not AI-generated video editing).



Requirements:

- At least 1 year of proven, hands-on experience editing video in professional editing software: DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut

- Demonstrated experience editing long-form content (documentary-style, story-driven, narrative pacing) — not just short-form or social/UGC ad content

- Strong sense of pacing, narrative structure, and visual storytelling suited to long-form documentary formats

- Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Nice to Have (Bonus):

- Experience editing documentary-style videos specifically

- Experience incorporating AI-generated visuals into an edit (footage/images into a cohesive narrative and looks). AI usages is minimal, but when used we expect to fit perfectly within the channel to the point that makes viewers doubt if it is AI-gen or not.



Research & Ownership:

We provide AI-assisted research files for each video as a starting point — but that's not the finish line. We expect the editor to do manual research on top of that: actually looking for the best factual images, footage, and b-roll, not defaulting to AI generation because it's faster.



AI image generation should be treated as a last resort, not a shortcut. It's easy to generate an image in two minutes instead of spending fifteen minutes finding a real, accurate one, but that approach leads to lazy, "slop" editing, and it's not what we're looking for.



We're flexible and understanding about the learning curve on channel style, tone, and formatting. What we're not able to do is walk an editor through the process step by step. We expect editors to own their work: research it, edit it, and QA and verify it themselves before submitting. The client isn't a safety net that will catch and flag every issue for you — that responsibility sits with the editor.



What We're NOT Looking For:

- Editors whose only experience is short-form, social media, or UGC-style ad content

- "AI storytelling" tools or AI video generation as a substitute for real editing skill

- Editors without hands-on experience in real editing software

- Editors who default to AI-generated images instead of doing real research

- Editors who need to be walked through the process step by step or rely on the client to catch their mistakes



Application Process (3 Phases):



Phase 1: Application Review Submit your application, portfolio, and relevant experience. Please read the full listing carefully before applying — we're specifically looking for long-form documentary editing experience, not short-form/social content.

Phase 2: Skills Sample Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short sample edit (60s, unpaid) to demonstrate hands-on skill.

Phase 3 — Paid Test Video Candidates who pass the sample round will be given one full video to edit at our standard rate ($35). Based on how this goes, top performers move into our ongoing rotation with more consistent work.



Thank you and looking forward to your application :)

title: Graphic Designer & Print Production Assistant
description:
# Graphic Designer & Print Production Assistant



**Remote | Part-Time – 24 Hours Per Week | Potential to Become Full-Time**



## About Us



We are an established Australian **promotional products, printing and branding company** helping businesses bring their brands to life.



We supply and customise a wide range of products, including:



* Corporate uniforms and workwear

* T-shirts, polos, jackets and apparel

* Caps and hats

* Drink bottles, cups and mugs

* Promotional merchandise

* Corporate gifts

* Banners and signage

* Business cards, flyers and printed materials

* Event and marketing products



We work with multiple Australian suppliers and production partners. Our customers provide their logos and branding, and we help turn these into professional **product mock-ups and production-ready artwork**.



## About the Role



We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented **Graphic Designer & Print Production Assistant** to join our team remotely.



This is **not purely a social media or Canva design role**.



A major part of this position involves preparing customer artwork for commercial printing, embroidery, screen printing, signage and promotional-product production.



You will work closely with our Australian team and suppliers to take customer logos and artwork from initial files through to **mock-up, customer approval and production-ready artwork**.



The position will initially be **24 hours per week**, with the potential to become full-time following a successful probation period.



## Key Responsibilities



### Graphic Design & Product Mock-Ups



* Create professional product mock-ups using customer logos and branding

* Place logos accurately onto apparel, uniforms, caps, drinkware, promotional products and other merchandise

* Make customer-requested artwork amendments

* Resize, adjust and clean supplied artwork

* Assist with basic logo modifications and artwork recreation

* Prepare customer approval proofs and presentations

* Maintain brand consistency across designs



### Print & Production Artwork



You will be expected to prepare artwork according to individual supplier specifications, including:



* Print-ready PDF files

* AI, EPS, SVG and other vector artwork

* CMYK colour setup

* Pantone/PMS colours

* Correct dimensions and artwork scaling

* Bleed and crop marks

* 300 DPI/high-resolution artwork

* Font outlining

* Logo/vector preparation

* Transparent backgrounds

* Embroidery and apparel logo positioning

* Banner and signage artwork

* Business cards, flyers, folders and other commercial print products



You will also assist with **uploading completed artwork into supplier portals for production**.



Accuracy is extremely important. You must be comfortable reading supplier artwork specifications and checking your work carefully before production.



## Software & Technical Skills



**Strong experience with Adobe Illustrator is highly preferred.**



Experience with the following is an advantage:



* Adobe Illustrator

* Adobe Photoshop

* Adobe InDesign

* CorelDRAW

* Acrobat/PDF editing

* Canva / Canva Pro

* Product mock-up software

* CapCut or similar video editing software



You should understand the difference between **vector and raster artwork** and be comfortable working with files such as **AI, EPS, SVG, PDF, PSD, PNG and JPG**.



## Social Media & Marketing Support



This role may also assist with:



* Creating Instagram and
 graphics

* Promotional banners and marketing materials

* Product launch graphics

* Reels and short-form video editing

* Scheduling social media content

* Updating website product images and graphics



Social media experience is an advantage, but **graphic design and production artwork skills are the priority for this position**.



## About You



We are looking for someone who is:



* Detail-oriented and accurate

* Creative but also technically minded

* Experienced in commercial print or production artwork

* Comfortable following supplier specifications

* Organised with files and artwork versions

* Able to manage multiple customer artwork requests

* Reliable when working remotely

* Comfortable communicating in English

* Able to work independently

* Willing to learn our products, suppliers and production processes

* Able to work some hours overlapping with Australian business hours



Experience working for a **printing company, signage company, promotional-products company, apparel printer, embroidery business or design/production agency** would be highly regarded.



## Hours



**24 hours per week initially**



There is potential for this role to become **full-time after probation** for the right person.



This is a long-term position. We are looking for someone who wants to learn our business and grow with the company.



## Paid Trial



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a **2-hour paid practical trial**.



The trial may include:



* Creating a branded product mock-up

* Preparing print-ready artwork

* Working from supplier artwork specifications

* Correcting or preparing a customer logo

* Preparing artwork for apparel, signage or commercial printing



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. Your portfolio

3. Your current location

4. Your expected hourly rate

5. Your weekly availability

6. The design software you use

7. Your experience with **Adobe Illustrator and vector artwork**

8. Examples of **print-ready or production artwork** you have prepared



Please also answer the following:



**What is the difference between a vector file and a raster image, and when would you use each for commercial printing?**



**If a customer sends you a low-resolution JPG logo but the supplier requires vector artwork, what would you do?**



**What experience do you have preparing CMYK/Pantone artwork, bleed, crop marks and outlined fonts for commercial printing?**



We are particularly interested in applicants who can demonstrate **real print-production knowledge**, not only social media or Canva design experience.

description:
Full-Time | Long-Term Role



SALARY



- $1,500 per month during Ramp / Trial period. Upon certification (typically 30–60 days), base increases to $2,000.

- On-Target Earnings are $2,500, including a $500 performance bonus (capped).

- Commission on renewals and upsells is uncapped and paid in addition to base and bonus.

- Additional performance-based incentives may apply.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



This is a long-term leadership role. You are not here to answer questions. You are here to ensure clients stay, progress, and succeed. You own retention, stability, and client momentum.



Client retention outcomes are directly linked to your performance reviews and income growth.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company serving 4,000+ clients since 2019.



We sell an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system helping creators go viral and generate income using short-form content and AI tools.



Most clients are 45+ beginners. They are motivated but often overwhelmed. They need clarity, structure, accountability, and calm leadership.



SCHEDULE



- Full-time, 7.5 hours per day, Monday to Friday.

- You can work your hours in one block or split them, as long as you consistently meet the job requirements.

- You will serve clients during your assigned 7.5-hour shift within our main coverage window (8am ET–2am ET)

- Must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET).



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Manage 40–50 clients after ramp-up (with systems and internal support in place).

- Run structured kickoff calls.

- Set clear expectations from day one.

- Own the client relationship end-to-end.

- Prevent churn and refund requests.

- Identify frustration early and de-escalate calmly.

- Handle difficult conversations professionally.

- Hold clients accountable to next steps.

- Follow up when clients go quiet.

- Ensure clients always know what to do next and why it matters.

- Respond within 24 hours (weekdays).

- Track progress clearly in CRM.

- Lead renewal conversations.

- Identify upsell opportunities when appropriate.

- Collect testimonials and referrals.

- Clients should never feel lost. You are responsible for clarity and momentum.



Preventable churn caused by communication gaps, missed follow-ups, or expectation mismanagement reflects on CSM performance. You are not responsible for factors outside your control.



HOW YOU WIN



- Clients stay in the program.

- Renewals remain strong.

- Refunds are rare.

- Clients feel clear and stable.

- Difficult situations are handled calmly.



REQUIREMENTS



- Near-native spoken English with very clear pronunciation for U.S.-based clients.

- Confident on Zoom.

- Strong emotional intelligence.

- Calm under pressure.

- High ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations.

- Proactive and organized.

- Reliable internet and professional home setup.

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines.



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success or Account Management

- High-ticket program

- Knowledge of social media monetization.

- Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.).



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here: 
/to/Su5De9Qc



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: TECHNICAL ONBOARDING MANAGER - $900 P/M + BONUSES (UP TO $1,400 P/M)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Content Writer & Content Strategist (SaaS & B2B)
description:
Help turn ideas into industry-leading content. 



At Hutility, we're building software that helps businesses work smarter—from ERP integrations to workforce management and AI-powered tools. We're looking for a curious, research-driven Content Strategist & Writer who enjoys learning complex topics and turning them into content that educates, builds trust, and drives organic growth. 



This isn't a traditional content writing role where you'll be handed topics and asked to write blog posts. 



Instead, you'll work closely with our leadership team and subject matter experts to uncover valuable ideas hidden inside customer conversations, meeting transcripts, product discussions, support tickets, and industry trends. You'll use AI as a research and productivity tool—not as a replacement for critical thinking—to create content people actually want to read. 



If you're naturally curious, enjoy interviewing people, and love connecting ideas, you'll fit right in. 



 



What You'll Do 



- Research our products, customers, competitors, and industry to identify valuable content opportunities.  

- Interview subject matter experts, product leaders, and internal teams to capture insights that aren't available through traditional keyword research.  

- Turn internal knowledge—including meeting transcripts, customer questions, support tickets, documentation, and product updates—into high-value content.  

- Develop content strategies that support SEO, AI search (AEO), thought leadership, and customer education.  

- Write and edit blogs, website content, LinkedIn posts, newsletters, case studies, product guides, landing pages, knowledge base articles, and video scripts.  

- Collaborate with SEO and leadership to prioritize topics based on customer needs, search behavior, and business goals.  

- Use AI tools to accelerate research, organize information, generate outlines, and improve productivity while ensuring every piece reflects human expertise and editorial judgment.  

- Repurpose long-form content into multiple formats across different channels.  

- Continuously improve content using performance insights, search trends, and audience feedback.  



 What We're Looking For 

We're less interested in someone who simply enjoys writing and more interested in someone who loves learning. 



You may be a great fit if you: 

- Are naturally curious and enjoy researching unfamiliar topics.  

- Can simplify technical or complex concepts into clear, engaging content.  

- Enjoy interviewing experts and asking thoughtful questions.  

- Think like a teacher, journalist, or investigator rather than just a copywriter.  

- Use AI to improve your workflow without relying on it to create generic content.  

- Can identify content opportunities independently rather than waiting for assignments.  

- Care about producing meaningful, insightful content—not just publishing for the sake of SEO.  



 Preferred Experience 

- 3+ years in Content Marketing, Content Strategy, Technical Writing, Product Marketing, or B2B Content Writing.  

- Experience creating content for SaaS, technology, ERP, HR software, AI, or B2B businesses.  

- Experience working with cross-functional teams, product managers, engineers, consultants, or subject matter experts.  

- Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and search intent.  

- Experience researching competitors and market trends.  



 Tools & Platforms (Experience with some is a plus) 

- AI & Research tools  

- SEO & Analytics 

- Google Search Console  

- Google Analytics  

- Content & Collaboration 

- WordPress or another CMS  

- Google Workspace  

- Notion  

- ClickUp or similar project management tools  

- Internal Knowledge Tools (Nice to Have) 

 



What Success Looks Like 

After your first few months, you'll be able to: 

- Consistently identify high-value content opportunities from internal knowledge and customer conversations.  

- Publish content that demonstrates real expertise rather than generic AI-generated articles.  

- Build repeatable workflows for transforming meetings, product updates, and customer feedback into blogs, LinkedIn posts, newsletters, documentation, and other content assets.  

- Help establish Hutility as a trusted voice in AI, ERP, workforce management, and business technology. 



How to Apply: 

Please submit your application through this link:  




 



We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, enjoys learning, and believes that great content comes from understanding—not just writing.
