title: Video Editor
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand running paid ads on Meta. We produce video ad creatives every week and we're looking for ONE editor to join our small team long-term.

Honesty upfront: I care more about who you are than what you know. If you're the type of person who shows up, takes ownership, and actually cares about doing good work — I want to talk to you. CapCut can be learned. Work ethic can't.

What you'll be doing.



What We're Looking For



• PACING AND STORYTELLING are everything. I don't care about fancy transitions or flashy effects. If you lead with that in your portfolio, we're not a fit. I care about whether someone watches for 3 seconds or 60. Fast cuts. B-roll that matches the emotional beat of the script. That's what I'm hiring for.



• You actually consume short-form content obsessively. I need someone who lives on TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels and understands what's working RIGHT NOW in August 2026. Not someone who learned trends 6 months ago. If you can tell me what hook formats are performing this week and why, you're already ahead of 90% of applicants.



• You understand organic formats. I'm not running polished corporate ads. I need content that feels native to the feed. If someone can't tell the difference between your ad and an organic post until they see "Sponsored," that's the goal. If your portfolio is full of clean, branded, studio-quality content, this isn't the role for you.



• You know how to generate AI assets. UGC avatars, AI voiceover, AI-generated b-roll, animated graphics, and product mockups. The ability to use AI tools to produce content that looks real and feels human is a core skill for this role, not a bonus.



• Speed over perfection. We test at high volume. 80% quality delivered fast beats 100% quality delivered slow. Every time. We'd rather test 15 variations this week than perfect 3 of them over two weeks.



• Visual appeal. We provide the text. It’s up to you to create what the viewer sees at the same time as they hear that text. This visual element is what sets a successful video apart from one that is ignored.



• Strong English, written and spoken. You'll be reading English scripts, placing English text overlays, and communicating with me daily in English. This needs to be sharp.



• Proactive communication. If something in the script doesn't work for video, tell me. If you have a better idea, share it. If you see a trending format we should test, bring it to me. I want a collaborator who's plugged in, not someone waiting for instructions.



• Reliability. Show up. Hit deadlines. Communicate if something is going to be late. Simple stuff that most people fail at.



• Production goal once production is underway: 15 to 20 videos per week.



Must-have skills:

Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or CapCut, demonstrated experience editing short VSLs and UGC content for Meta ads specifically, subtitle and caption editing across multiple languages, some experience creating or editing organic TikTok content, and a reliable internet connection with the ability to handle large video files.



Nice to have:

Experience with ElevenLabs or any AI voiceover tools for multilingual dubbing, familiarity with direct response marketing concepts (hooks, open loops, social proof, CTAs), and basic motion graphics or text animation for captions and overlays.



We offer:

- A competitive monthly salary, paid weekly or bi-weekly (whichever you prefer);

- A long-term position within a rapidly growing company;

- Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and briefs;

- Bonuses for winning ads;

- Flexible hours, asynchronous work, and creative freedom.



HOW TO APPLY

Send us your portfolio with at least 3 examples of video ads you have edited or produced. TikTok content examples are a plus. Please indicate the editing software you use and the AI tools you are proficient with. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



We're not looking for executors. We're looking for creative minds who can help us create videos that make people click, laugh, cry, and buy.

title: Hail-Zone Outbound SDR / Roofing Appointment Setter
description:
Everlast Roofing & Restoration is looking for a confident, experienced outbound caller to help generate qualified roof inspections in Colorado hail-impacted areas.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. Your primary responsibility is simple: identify and contact homeowners in targeted hail zones, qualify potential roofing opportunities, and schedule legitimate roof inspections for our sales team.



We are looking for someone who understands that results matter. You will be measured on activity, conversations, appointments booked, and appointments that actually hold.



Responsibilities:



* Build and work targeted homeowner lists in Colorado hail-impacted areas

* Research, verify, and organize homeowner/property contact information

* Make high-volume outbound calls and follow-up attempts

* Speak confidently with homeowners about potential hail/storm damage

* Qualify homeowners before scheduling an inspection

* Handle common objections and continue conversations toward an appointment

* Schedule inspections directly onto our calendar

* Follow up with interested homeowners who are not ready to schedule immediately

* Maintain accurate notes and dispositions inside our CRM

* Track and report daily dials, contacts, conversations, bookings, and held appointments



A qualified appointment means the homeowner owns the property, is located within our target area, has a reasonable potential roofing or storm-damage need, agrees to a specific inspection date and time, and understands why our representative is coming to the property.



Requirements:



* Minimum 1 year of outbound cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

* Previous experience calling U.S. customers strongly preferred

* Strong spoken English with clear and confident communication

* Comfortable making 100+ outbound attempts per day

* Experience handling objections and directly asking for appointments

* Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment

* Ability to work U.S. Mountain Time hours

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Reliable computer and quality headset

* Quiet professional workspace

* Experience using a CRM such as GoHighLevel or similar software

* Must be organized and consistent with follow-up

* Must be comfortable having performance tracked daily



We are especially interested in applicants with previous experience in roofing, solar, home services, insurance restoration, real estate, or other high-ticket appointment-setting environments.



Performance Expectations:



The goal of this position is to consistently generate qualified roof inspections for our sales team. We will track outbound attempts, contacts, qualified conversations, appointments booked, appointments held, and conversion rates.



We are not looking for someone who simply completes hours or tasks. We want someone who takes ownership of the numbers, recognizes when results are behind target, and adjusts their approach accordingly.



Application Requirements:



To be considered, begin your application with the word HAIL.



Your application must include:



* A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself

* Your previous outbound calling or appointment-setting experience

* The types of customers or industries you have called

* Your average number of outbound calls per day in previous roles

* Your best appointment-setting results or performance metrics

* Your experience handling objections

* Your availability to work U.S. Mountain Time

* A brief answer to this question: If you made 100 calls and booked zero appointments, what would you change before making the next 100?



Applications that do not include the requested information and voice recording will not be considered.



Compensation:



$5/hour plus $25 for each qualified inspection that is completed.



This role has room to grow for someone who consistently produces results and demonstrates strong ownership of their performance.

title: Crypto Business Development Manager | Partnerships & Appointment Setting
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

D. $250 partnership bonus when a partnership you originated or materially managed goes live AND at least $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain). An announcement or deployment with no qualifying mints does not pay

E. Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

F. No cap on appointment bonuses. One bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

G. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

H. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Superstar Operations VA
description:
Operations VA - No Degree or Experience Needed. English MUST be good. Sharp Problem-Solvers Only.



## JOB TYPE

Full-time (40 hrs/week)



## SALARY

$350 to $600 per month, paid on time, every time. Starting rate depends on how you perform in our hiring process. Not on your resume.



---



## JOB DESCRIPTION



**Read this whole post carefully. How you apply is the first test.**



We're a fast-growing international social media marketing agency (US-registered). We manage content operations and social accounts for online creators.



We're hiring an Operations VA to become a core part of our team. The work includes managing trackers and reports in Google Sheets, online research, keeping our SOPs updated, coordinating follow-ups across the team, inbox and schedule support, and whatever fires need putting out that week. The tasks are trainable. What we can't train is how you think, that's what we're hiring for.



**Why this role is different from your last VA job:**



- **We don't care about your degree.** College grad, undergrad, no degree — irrelevant. We will never ask.

- **We don't care about your years of experience.** We'd rather hire a sharp first-timer than a 5-year VA with bad habits.

- **We pay above market** because we expect above-market thinking. One great VA is worth more to us than three average ones and is paid like it.

- **You'll be trusted with real responsibility.** We don't micromanage. We give you the goal, you figure out the path, you flag problems early.



**You're the right person if:**



- When instructions are unclear, you make a smart assumption, state it, and keep moving — you don't freeze or go silent

- When a tool is unfamiliar, you Google it and figure it out before asking

- When something breaks, you flag it immediately instead of hiding it

- You deliver before deadlines without being reminded

- Your written English is clear enough that a US client could read it without confusion



**Do NOT apply if:**



- You need step-by-step instructions for every task

- You're currently juggling 2–3 other clients (this is full-time and exclusive)

- You go offline when things get hard

- You're the type to say "I don't know how" as a final answer



**Pay & perks:**



- $400 to $650 per month. Depending on performance in our process

- Paid training, paid hiring test tasks, performance raises reviewed every 6 months

- Long-term role — we're building a team, not renting freelancers



---



## HOW TO APPLY -

Fill up this form below. Do not use AI, we have AI detection. Your effort in filling up this form with your sincere answer will determine you pass or not.

*Testing and optimization

     - Match the metric to the test: subject lines to open rate, CTAs to click rate, everything ultimately to revenue

*Deliverability and metrics

 deliverability tab, list hygiene, engagement filters, sunset policies

 programs and bring the strongest ideas back

 (or deep experience in Iterable, Braze, or Klaviyo with proven ability to switch): segments, event-triggered journeys, Liquid personalization, conversion goals, webhooks

     - Fluent in
 authentication and infrastructure: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, one-click unsubscribe, and the current Gmail/Yahoo bulk sender requirements

     - Strong list hygiene instincts: sunset policies, engagement tiering, re-permission campaigns, suppression management, bounce classification (hard vs soft, and what to do with each)

     - Disciplined experimenter: single-variable A/B tests, correct metric per test, statistical patience, clean resolution, documented learnings

     - Sharp direct-response copywriting: subject lines, preview text, CTAs that get clicked by a US consumer audience

     - Data fluency: you can pull your own numbers, separate machine opens from human opens, calculate revenue per send/click, and spot when a metric shift is a tracking bug vs a real change

ing large consumer lists (100k+) where reputation mistakes are expensive

- What creatives get made.

- Strong direct response mindset. You care about results, not just aesthetics.

- Deep understanding of hooks, angles, retention, and creative testing.

- High attention to detail and structured way of thinking.

title: Telecom Ops / VoIP Specialist — US DID Health, STIR/SHAKEN, Spam Label Remediation
description:
We run outbound calling to US-based customers for our clients. Our numbers are getting tagged "Spam Likely" / "Scam Likely" and connect rates are dying.



We need someone who has actually fixed this before. Not a dialer agent. Not a general VA.



## What you'll do

- Audit our current DIDs, carriers and dialer setup, tell us what's broken

- Register numbers properly: STIR/SHAKEN attestation, CNAM, Branded Caller ID

- Submit and chase remediation with Hiya, First Orion, TNS, Numeracle and the carriers directly

- Set up monitoring so we see a number degrading before it gets flagged

- Fix the behavioural causes: call pacing, short-duration ratio, ANI velocity, answer rate, complaint rate

- Keep us clean on DNC scrubbing and calling-window rules

- Document the whole thing as an SOP our team can run



## You must have

- Real hands-on experience remediating spam-flagged US numbers (tell us about it)

- Direct dealings with a carrier or provider (Twilio, Telnyx, Bandwidth, Vonage, Commio, etc.)

- Working knowledge of STIR/SHAKEN attestation levels and why A vs B matters

- Familiarity with a dialer (V
, Five9, Convoso, or similar)

- Clear written English



## This is not for you if

- Your only answer is "buy new numbers and rotate them"

- You have never spoken to a carrier

- You need us to teach you what CNAM is



## Terms

- Gig / project-based, paid hourly. High rate for the right person.

- Starts with a paid audit of our current setup. If it's good, ongoing retainer.

- Flexible hours, but some overlap with US business hours for carrier calls.



## To apply

Start your message with the word ORANGE so we know you read this. Then answer:

1. Describe one number you got un-flagged. What was the actual cause and what fixed it?

2. Which registries or portals have you personally submitted to?

3. Which single metric do you watch first to predict a number going bad?

4. Your hourly rate in USD.



Applications without the code word and all four answers are deleted unread.

title: Law Firm Business Development & Growth Manager
description:
Job description:



Our Law Firm is a California law firm handling business and corporate transactional work, i.e., entity formations, governance, contracts and commercial agreements, compliance counseling, negotiations, and sports- and entertainment-related business matters, alongside a personal injury practice. We are hiring one person to build and run the firm's client-development engine.



This is not a social-media coordinator role. You will own marketing and business development end to end: where qualified work comes from, which channels deserve investment, how leads are tracked, and how inquiries become consultations. If you want a role where your judgment shows up directly in the firm's growth, this is it. If you want a marketing department around you, it isn't.



About the Opportunity



Small firm, large surface area. You will work directly with the firm's owner and build systems rather than inherit them. There is no legacy marketing infrastructure to defend and no committee between you and a decision. What you build here, you will be able to point to for the rest of your career.



Because this is a law firm, growth happens inside professional-responsibility rules. Advertising, outreach, and intake run through attorney-approved systems and remain subject to attorney supervision. You will never be asked to give legal advice, evaluate a matter, or d
 whether the firm accepts a representation, the attorneys do that. Within those boundaries, you have real latitude to test, build, and d
.



What You'll Own



Client-acquisition strategy — identify where qualified business realistically comes from for both practice areas, then build the channels to reach it

Referral and partnership development — cultivate professional referral relationships, strategic partnerships, associations, conferences, and sponsorships appropriate for a law firm

Lead generation and funnels — landing pages, offers, calls to action, and disciplined channel testing

CRM and pipeline — MyCase workflows, lead attribution, source tracking, and clean data you can actually trust

Intake support — strengthen attorney-approved intake and nurture processes so qualified inquiries reach a consultation instead of going cold

Digital — organic search and content strategy,
 campaigns and nurture sequences, social media strategy, and Google/Meta advertising where the economics justify it

Website and collateral — coordinate site improvements; produce professional materials in Canva or comparable tools

Measurement — KPIs and attribution; cost per lead, qualified-lead rate, consultation rate, conversion rate, and spend efficiency; weekly or monthly growth reporting

Systemization — document what works so successful acquisition methods become repeatable

Initiative — bring the firm growth experiments rather than waiting to be handed a plan

What We're Looking For



Required / Core Qualifications



Roughly three or more years in legal marketing, law firm business development, professional-services growth, intake optimization, or a comparable revenue-development role

Client-acquisition work you personally built or materially operated — not work you supported from the edges

Hands-on CRM implementation and pipeline management

Working command of paid acquisition, SEO and content,
, analytics, and conversion optimization

Comfort being accountable to measurable results, and the judgment to tell activity apart from results

Understanding that legal-industry marketing operates within professional-responsibility constraints, and the discipline to work inside them

California-based and authorized to work in the United States

Strongly Preferred



Law firm or professional-services experience

Transactional and business-law marketing: formations, corporate work, contracts, partnerships, governance, compliance, commercial transactions

Personal injury marketing or intake experience

Business-development background, relationships, or demonstrated success in sports, athletics, athlete representation ecosystems, entertainment, or media

MyCase — not required if you have run other CRMs and learn new systems quickly

What Success Looks Like



Success is measured by what you can genuinely influence: qualified leads generated, pipeline created, new referral and source channels developed, CRM discipline, quality campaigns that convert potential clients, into clients, improvement in conversion from qualified inquiry to attorney consultation, lead quality, cost efficiency, and marketing ROI where it can be measured reliably. We are not asking anyone to guarantee outcomes. We are asking for systems whose results can be seen and repeated.



Compensation



Pay incentives tied to marketing and business-development metrics — qualified lead generation, consultation volume, campaign and channel performance, and contribution to overall firm growth. Consistent with California professional-responsibility rules, incentive compensation is not tied to fees, settlements, or recoveries from any particular client or matter.



Incentive terms will be provided to you in writing. The firm provides or reimburses the equipment, software, and services reasonably and approved by firm as required to do the job, as California law requires.



Location & Work Arrangement



Although the firm is based in California, you are not required to be a California-based professional. However, you will need availability during California business hours when the work reasonably requires it, a professional remote-work environment, and reliable connectivity. The firm operates virtually but meets clients in person on request, so occasional in-person meetings or industry events in Southern California may come up (at this time you will not be expected to attend those in-person meetings/events).



How to Apply



Apply here with your résumé and brief answers to the application questions. We are looking for specifics, not polish. Please be prepared to tell us:



Your law firm or professional-services business-development experience

Two or three campaigns, funnels, referral channels, or systems you personally built or materially operated

Measurable results from that work, where you can lawfully share them

The tools, CRMs, and advertising platforms you have personally used

Your experience, if any, with transactional legal services

Your experience, if any, with personal injury

Your experience, relationships, or business-development background, if any, in sports or entertainment

Your answer to this: If you joined a small California law firm tomorrow and were responsible for building its client-development engine, what would you evaluate during your first 30 days?

Do not include confidential, privileged, proprietary, or former-client information in your examples. Describe the work generally and share figures only where you can do so lawfully.



Are You Ready To Join The Team



We are hiring one person for this. We would rather wait for someone who can both think and execute than fill the seat quickly. If that is you, your 30-day answer will tell us more than your résumé will.



Benefits:





Flexible schedule

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply



Application Question(s):





How many years have you worked in legal marketing, law firm business development, or professional-services revenue development?

Describe one client-acquisition system, funnel, or referral channel you personally built. What did it produce?

Which CRMs and advertising platforms have you personally used, and in what capacity?

Do you have experience marketing transactional/business legal services? Describe briefly.

Do you have experience with personal injury marketing or intake? Describe briefly.

Do you have business-development experience or relationships in sports, athletics, entertainment, or media?

If you joined a small California law firm tomorrow and were responsible for building its client-development engine, what would you evaluate during your first 30 days?

Are authorized to work in the United States; and where are you based?

title: Arkero Growth Partner | sales end to end
description:
Growth Partner – Australia NZ| Remote | Commission-Based



Arkero is building a new era of staffing.



We connect Australian and New Zealand businesses with skilled professionals in the Philippines, supported by technology designed to make the entire staffing process faster, simpler and easier for the client.



Our goal is simple: make staffing easier to sell, easier to buy and dramatically faster to deliver.



As we prepare to launch, we are expanding our network of Growth Partners across Australia.



This opportunity is for people who are confident in their ability to build relationships, generate business and close clients.



A System Designed to Be Simple to Sell



We have deliberately built Arkero to remove as much friction as possible from the staffing decision.



There are no placement fees and no upfront recruitment fees.



The client is not being asked to spend thousands of dollars before a staff member even starts.



That removes one of the biggest barriers in traditional recruitment and staffing.



The conversation becomes much simpler.



A business identifies where it needs support.



The Growth Partner works with the client to understand the role, shows them how Arkero can solve the problem and gets the business to commit to taking on a remote professional.



From there, Arkero’s talent, technology and operations teams handle the placement process.



That means Growth Partners can stay focused on what they do best: starting conversations, building relationships, closing business and generating placements.



This Is a New Era for Staffing



Traditional staffing can be slow, expensive and heavily dependent on manual recruitment.



Clients can face large upfront recruitment fees and then still wait weeks for a suitable candidate.



Arkero is being built differently.



No placement fees. No upfront recruitment fees. Less friction. Faster decisions.



Our platform is designed to use technology and AI to help identify suitable talent, streamline workflows and dramatically reduce the time it takes to make a placement.



Our long-term goal is to move from the traditional model of waiting weeks for a candidate to making suitable placements possible in minutes.



That gives Growth Partners a very different proposition to take to market.



You are not asking a business to pay a large fee just to begin the recruitment process.



You are helping them identify where they need support, showing them a simpler staffing model and getting them comfortable committing to bringing a remote professional into the business.



The Growth Partner Opportunity



As an Arkero Growth Partner, you will develop your own sector or market and build relationships with businesses that could benefit from remote staffing.



Your role will include:



Identifying and approaching potential clients



Building relationships with business owners and decision-makers



Understanding where remote professionals can remove workload and improve operations



Identifying genuine staffing needs inside the business



Explaining the Arkero model and why it is different



Handling the commercial conversation



Overcoming objections



Getting the client to commit to taking on a staff member



Developing and managing your own pipeline



Building a strong presence within your chosen sector



Growing existing client relationships into further placements where there is a genuine need



Once the client has committed to taking on a staff member, Arkero’s talent and operations teams take over the placement process.



You win the business. We deliver the placement.



Life-Changing Earning Potential



This is a commission-based Growth Partner opportunity.



There is no fixed salary and there is no artificial cap on what a successful Growth Partner can build.



Your income is directly connected to the business and placements you generate.



For someone who can consistently win clients and generate placements, the earning potential can be life-changing.



And because there are no placement fees or upfront recruitment fees for the client, we have deliberately removed friction from the sales process.



The aim is to give Growth Partners a proposition that is genuinely easier to take to market.



Staffing is also not always a one-placement sale.



A single successful client may require multiple people.



A business may start with one remote professional and later expand into administration, customer support, bookkeeping, sales support, marketing or other functions.



That means one strong client relationship can potentially create multiple placements and significant value over time.



The opportunity is not simply about making individual sales.



It is about building a genuine client portfolio.



Who This Suits



This opportunity will suit people who:



Back their own ability



Are confident starting conversations



Know how to build trust with business owners



Can create their own pipeline



Know how to close



Are comfortable asking for the business



Can move a conversation from interest to commitment



Are comfortable working independently



Understand that strong client relationships create long-term value



Want their earning potential connected directly to their performance



Want to build something rather than simply step into an established sales territory



Experience in business development, B2B sales, recruitment, partnerships or account management is highly valuable.



You do not need to be a recruitment expert.



You need to understand businesses, uncover staffing needs and be able to turn those conversations into committed placements.



Why Now



Arkero is early.



Australia and New Zealand are our first markets, but the platform is being built for much broader expansion.



That creates an opportunity for Growth Partners joining now to establish sectors, relationships and client portfolios while the company is still growing.



We believe staffing is entering a new era.



No placement fees. No upfront fees. Faster placements. Less friction.



Technology can remove the delays.



AI can remove repetitive work.



The platform can make the process dramatically easier.



But businesses still need someone who can understand their problem, build trust and get them to make a decision.



That is the role of the Growth Partner.



If you back your ability, know how to win business and want an opportunity where the earning potential can genuinely be life-changing, we want to hear from you.

We run paid video ads and we need volume. We're hiring one full-time editor to make simple product ads, every day, long term.

Simple short-form video ads. We give you the footage, the images, and the brief. You cut it, add captions, export it. That's the job.

Pay

$6 USD per finished video.



At 10 videos a day that's $60 a day. Full-time, six days a week, that's roughly $1,500+ per month.



Paid twice a month, on time, every time. There is no cap — if you deliver more, you earn more.



A video counts as finished when it's delivered on time, follows the brief, is the right format, and the captions are clean. If something needs fixing I'll tell you exactly what in one sentence, and it counts once you fix it.

Hours

Full-time, Monday to Sunday, normal daytime hours in your own timezone. No night shift neccessary.



This is one job, not a side gig. We want someone who is here every day, not juggling other clients.

What you need

You can edit simple short-form video quickly and consistently

CapCut, Premiere, or Resolve — whatever you're fastest in

A computer that can actually handle 10 exports a day

Stable internet, and a backup plan when the power goes out

Replace EDITOR with Bombaclat inte the title when applying for this job.

You can commit to 7 days a week, long term



Experience with paid ads is a plus, not a requirement. We'll teach you our formats.

How to apply

Title structure: EDITOR | [videos you can finish per day] | [your main software] | [your internet speed]

In your message, keep it short and answer these three things:



The most short-form videos you've ever finished in one day, and what they were for.

Your computer specs, your internet speed, and what you do when the power goes out.

Two or three links to simple ads or short-form videos you've edited. Not a full reel — pick your most relevant ones.

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor / Content Creator
description:
We are a creative agency looking for a full-time short-form content creator/video editor to help produce high-volume social content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.



This is an ongoing position with consistent work and the opportunity to grow with our team.



You will be assigned different social accounts, topics, personalities, films, brands, or campaigns.



A major part of this position is content research and discovery. We will provide source material when available, but you will also be expected to independently research the internet and find relevant publicly available content and potential source material for the accounts you're working on.



For example, if you're creating content around an actor, film, or entertainment property, you should be comfortable researching interviews, press appearances, behind-the-scenes material, older moments, trending conversations, and other relevant sources.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Researching the internet for relevant content ideas and potential source material

* Keeping track of where source material came from and using only material approved for the campaign

* Finding interesting, funny, emotional, entertaining, nostalgic, or attention-grabbing moments

* Identifying strong moments within longer videos without needing timestamps provided

* Turning approved material into engaging short-form vertical videos

* Creating strong hooks and on-screen text

* Adding captions, subtitles, graphics, sound design, and music when appropriate

* Creating multiple creative variations from source material

* Researching trends and understanding what audiences are currently responding to

* Bringing your own content ideas and concepts to the team

* Following examples, references, and creative direction

* Organizing source material and completed content

* Producing content consistently every workday





We're looking for someone who genuinely understands TikTok, Reels, Shorts, internet culture, and what makes someone stop scrolling.



You should be comfortable finding content and ideas yourself. We do not want someone who needs every clip, timestamp, or idea handed to them.



The ideal candidate can research a subject, find interesting material, recognize what could become a strong social post, and then execute the edit.



We're especially interested in:



* Strong internet research skills

* Strong creative instincts

* Understanding short-form pacing and hooks

* Knowing how to find interesting moments and stories

* Understanding current social trends and editing styles

* Speed and consistency

* Strong editing fundamentals

* Motion graphics, sound design, or advanced editing abilities

* Bringing new ideas to the team

* Following creative direction

* Staying organized

* Being receptive to feedback



CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, or similar editing software is welcome.



If you have experience with advanced editing, motion graphics, After Effects, sound design, or cinematic content, please include examples. We would love to see what else you can do.



We're looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our content team.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Links to 3–5 of your best short-form videos

3. A link to any advanced editing, motion graphics, or other work you're especially proud of

4. What editing software you use

5. How many short-form videos you believe you could realistically research, create, and deliver during an 8-hour workday

6. Whether you're comfortable independently researching the internet to find content and ideas

7. Briefly describe how you would find content for a social account when the client has not provided you with source footage



Please begin your application with the word WAGON so we know you read the full job description.



Selected applicants will be invited to complete a small paid test involving both content research and editing before we make a full-time hire.

rather than:

title: Digital Marketing Executor
description:
Digital Marketing Executor



Remote · Full-Time · Long-Term · Philippines-based · No Night Shift Needed





Who We Are



We're Fresh Tech Maid (
), a Chicago residential cleaning company. We clean homes with physics, not chemicals: deionized water, hypochlorous 
 steam vapor, and HEPA filtration. Our cleaning technicians are W-2 employees — trained, background-checked, and serving families across Chicago, Evanston, and Arlington Heights. Parents with young kids, pet owners, and seniors choose us because a healthy, chemical-free home is the whole point.



Our founder has 20+ years in the service industry, a Wharton MBA, a #1 Amazon bestselling book on service-industry hiring. The marketing strategy, the content calendar, and the brand voice guide are already built. That's where you come in.



Who We Need



We need an experienced digital marketing executor. Not a trainee. Not someone starting from zero.



The strategy exists. The task list exists. The brand voice is documented. We need the person who executes it with discipline and proves it with numbers every week.



We live by the optimize — measure — learn cycle. Every project has a number. Every number gets tracked. Every result shapes what we do next. If that's how you already work, keep reading.



Are You This Person?



(1) Accountable. You own your numbers. You don't blame tools, the market, or the algorithm.

(2) Deadline-driven. You hit dates. When something slips, you flag it early.

(3) Data-first. You check dashboards before you share opinions.

(4) Measurement-minded. You think in baselines, targets, and deltas.

(5) Curious. You ask “what's working?” and “why?” every week.

(6) Honest. You say when something isn't working. No sugarcoating, no spin.



What You'll Do



You'll execute the marketing system that brings Chicago homeowners into our pipeline — leads, booked cleanings, and five-star reviews. Real projects, real numbers, real deadlines:



(1) Content engine (the core) — format and publish the weekly pillar blog (the founder provides outlines and approves every draft), refresh older posts with updated titles and section headers, and keep the content calendar on time in our documented house style.

(2) Social system — turn each pillar into platform-native posts: 3 posts per week each on
, Instagram, Google Business Profile, and YouTube. Our rules are documented and strict: at least 90% of posts carry no external link, and we publish six value posts for every one ask.

(3) LinkedIn newsletter — prepare the weekly skeleton from the latest pillar; the founder writes the final version in his own voice; you format, schedule, and track it.

(4) Link building (relationship-first) — work our researched list of 47 Chicago-area influencers across 14 content categories. Add value first, build the relationship, earn the mention. No paid placements and no cold spam blasts — we've tested that; relationships are what work.

(5) Pillar Blogs for Neighborhood pages — produce two per month in coordination with our webmaster. Quality is capped on purpose: no thin pages, no shortened clones of our pillar content.

(6) Reviews & referrals — keep our after-cleaning follow-up system supplied: the two-touch review campaign, referral credits, and QR review cards. Our client service manager owns review velocity; you own the materials and tracking behind it.

(7) Lead magnets &
 — connect our lead magnets to an
 platform (Mailchimp, ConvertKit, or similar) and run the nurture campaigns end to end.

(8) Local Services Ads pilot — in later months, help launch and track our Google Local Services Ads test against a strict cost-per-booked-job guardrail.

(9) Reporting — update the KPI workbook weekly: leads by source, geo-grid rankings, reviews across our three locations, GA4, Search Console, social insights, link status, and our rankings inside AI tools. Flag what's moving and what isn't.

(10) Team support (startup flexibility) — we're a small team, so when the week demands it, you help with admin, sales support, client service, and other tasks. Marketing is your core job, but nobody here says “that's not my job.”



Website changes, sales calls, and client delivery are led by the founder and the rest of the team — our webmaster owns the website, our sales team owns the phone, and our client service manager owns the client experience. You coordinate with them and jump in to support when asked — they own those areas; you keep marketing moving.



Every project has a goal. Every goal has a number. Every number gets reviewed.



Your Background



(1) 3+ years of real, hands-on digital marketing experience running content and social media for a business (coursework alone won't cut it). Local or consumer service brands are a plus.

(2) Strong written English — short, clear, persuasive. You'll write in the founder's documented voice, and shortlisted candidates complete a short writing sample.

(3) Hands-on social media management across
, Instagram, and YouTube. Google Business Profile experience is a plus.

(4) Basic video editing for short-form content (Descript or similar) — cutting, captioning, and formatting for vertical video.

(5) Comfort with an
 platform (Mailchimp or similar), GA4, and AI writing tools.

(6) A track record of setting goals, measuring results, and hitting targets.

(7) A 4-year Bachelor's degree.

(8) Honesty about what you know and what you still need to learn.



Nice to have: local SEO (Semrush, Google Business Profile), blogger and influencer outreach, Webflow, and home-services marketing.



How We Work (this is the deal)



(1) Daily async check-in (15 lines: what shipped yesterday, what ships today, blockers). We do not use surveillance or screen-monitoring software. We manage by visible output, not watched hours — your work must be visible: posts published,
s sent, pages live, dashboard updated.

(2) Weekly 1-hour Zoom with the founder to review the KPI dashboard.

(3) Schedule: a full-time engagement (about 40 hours/week of focused work) with 4 hours overlapping US Central mornings as a communication window.

(4) No graveyard shift: as only 4-hour overlapping, you do not need to work in graveyard shift.

(5) Dedicated, quiet workspace with reliable internet plus a backup for internet and power. This is a stay-in-place role — not a work-while-traveling role; nomad setups don't deliver the reliability this position needs.

(6) Exclusivity: this is a full-time commitment — you won't take on other clients while engaged with us.

(7) Company tools provided under a company
 we set up for you 
 platform, AI writing tools, video tools, and the rest). 



You never use personal accounts for company work.



Growth Path & Pay



This role has a clear growth ladder. As your measured results grow, your pay grows.



Level 1 (Intermediate) - $8/hour-equivalent

Level 2 (Intermediate plus) - $9/hour-equivalent

Level 3 (Advanced Specialist) - $10/hour-equivalent

Level 4 (Master Marketer) - $11/hour-equivalent

Level 5 (Authority Expert) - $12/hour-equivalent

Level 6 (Growth Partner) - $13/hour-equivalent

Level 7 (Marketing Leader) - $14/hour-equivalent

Level 8 (Marketing Leader) - $15/hour-equivalent



Because this role requires proven experience, qualified hires enter at Level 2–3 (a fixed monthly salary of roughly $1,440–$1,600) based on demonstrated skills. We pay a fixed monthly salary for the role and your availability window — not an hourly timesheet. From there we move people up based on measured results, not tenure. A modest quarterly bonus is tied to campaign outcomes (lead volume, booked cleanings, and review growth); your base never depends on outcomes outside your control.



Benefits



(1) Company-paid AI tools built into everything we do

(2) Honest, ethical managers — direct support from the founder

(3) A documented training/onboarding program (you ramp in weeks, not months)

(4) A clear path to higher pay and more responsibility

(5) 6 paid US National Holidays

(6) 5 paid personal days in Year 1; 10 from Year 2

(7) As only 4-hour overlapping, you do not need to work in graveyard shift.



Our Culture & Values



(1) Direct, honest, empathetic communication

(2) Always learning — optimize, measure, learn

(3) Data-driven, not ego-driven

(4) Team connection — no one left isolated

(5) Integrity, every time



How We Hire



This role matters to us, so we take hiring seriously:



A short survey.

A small paid work sample (a short piece written in our brand voice from an outline we provide).

A video interview with a live screen-share of a content or social campaign you personally ran — show us the numbers.

A Zoom interview with the founder.

A paid 4-week trial at full salary, with real deliverables and clear, written acceptance criteria agreed before you start. We may run this trial with more than one candidate at the same time — if so, we'll tell you openly, and everyone is paid in full. Pass the trial ? permanent, long-term role.



We're looking for one person to grow with for years — not a contractor for a month.



How to Apply?



Include the words “Chemical Free” in the first line of your application. List 3 reasons why you are a good fit.

If you've read this far and you're the disciplined, detail-driven executor we're describing, we want to hear from you.

title: Recruiting Manager - US Healthcare Staffing - Night Shift, Remote
description:
Type: Full-Time | Pay: $1,400–$1,800/month base (experience-based, night differential included) + monthly performance commission | Hours: 40/week | Schedule: Fixed US night shift, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM MST, Mon–Fri



About the Role



A US-based healthcare direct-hire staffing firm is looking for a Recruiting Manager to lead delivery for our lean, offshore recruiting team. This is not a "carry your own req" role — you'll own the funnel and the people: screening, quality control, coaching, and turning pipeline into client submissions every week. All clients and placed candidates are US-based; this is a fully remote, Philippines-based leadership seat with real authority.



You'll inherit a team already supported by AI systems that handle sourcing, list-building, outreach, and daily worklists. Your job is the part that AI can't do: screening candidates at volume, enforcing quality, coaching your recruiters, and hitting our delivery standard of 15 screened submissions per week across the team.



What You'll Own



Delivery: every submission is recruiter-screened with license/credential verification completed before it goes out — no exceptions. You're accountable for the submit-to-interview ratio and time-to-fill.



People: direct management of a Senior Recruiter and appointment setter(s), growing to a 3–5 person pod — onboarding, weekly coaching through call reviews, performance management, and making tough calls on underperformers when needed.



Cadence: running daily standups against AI-generated worklists — the day's screens, submits, and follow-ups are queued each morning; you drive execution.



Reporting: a weekly KPI scorecard to the owner covering submissions, interviews, placements, and per-recruiter production — pulled straight from the ATS.





What You Bring



-Four or more years of US healthcare staffing experience on the agency side, personally recruiting US healthcare professionals (allied health/imaging, nursing, or physicians), including direct-hire/permanent placement work.

-At least one year directly managing recruiters or sourcers — assigning reqs, owning their numbers, coaching them, and holding them accountable (not just mentoring peers).

-Fluency with recruiting metrics — you can speak confidently, fro
mory, about what strong weekly production looks like (submissions, interview rate, placements) and what your own team has delivered.

-Strong spoken English, since you'll run standups, coach recruiters live, and occasionally speak with US clients. A recorded voice sample and live spoken interview are part of our process.

-The ability to commit long-term to the fixed US night shift (8:00 AM–5:00 PM MST) with a reliable home setup: quiet space, headset, stable internet, and backup power/data.

-Comfort working in an ATS (Manatal or similar) alongside AI-driven sourcing and outreach tools.



Compensation & Growth



$1,400–$1,800/month base depending on experience, plus monthly performance commission tied to team placements — the better your pod performs, the more you earn (specifics discussed at offer). Paid reliably and on time via Wise.



This is a long-term seat with genuine authority: input on hiring, performance management, and a direct line to the owner. Clear growth path from Recruiting Manager to Head of Delivery as the team scales.



This Role Is a Strong Fit If You...



-Have hands-on US healthcare staffing/recruiting agency experience (not PH-local or non-US recruiting).

-Have directly managed recruiters — and can speak to your team's real numbers.

-Have led in a recruiting context specifically, not BPO customer service, collections, or support.

-Can commit to the fixed US night shift long-term.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with answers to the following. Applications missing the resume or any of the six answers will not be reviewed:



1. Your US healthcare staffing experience — agency name(s), years at each, which US healthcare roles you recruited, and the split between direct-hire/permanent vs. travel/contract work.



2. The team you led — how many recruiters/sourcers reported directly to you, for how long, and one real example of managing an underperformer (what you did, week by week, and the outcome).



3. Your team's numbers for one recent normal month — submissions per recruiter/week, submit-to-interview %, and placements — plus your own personal production numbers from when you carried a desk.



4. A link to a 60–90 second voice recording explaining how you'd run a 5-person US healthcare recruiting desk to 15 screened submissions/week, including your standup approach, the 3 KPIs you'd track, how you'd enforce screen quality, and your own production numbers stated out loud. This is the most important part of your application.



5. Confirmation you can commit to the fixed US night shift long-term, plus your home setup details (internet speed, headset, quiet space, backup power/internet).



6. Your current or most recent monthly pay and your earliest possible start date.

title: AI-Savvy Business & Property Assistant – Part-Time | Long-Term
description:
20 Hours Per Week | Performance Bonuses | Long-Term Opportunity



We are a growing UK business group involved in property, property investment, training, consulting and business services, looking for an exceptional part-time assistant to become an important member of our team.



This is a varied role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and getting things done.



You will support the business across areas including:



Lead generation and online research

Property seller and investor follow-up

CRM management and follow-through

Customer and student communication

Social media and content support

General business administration

Using ChatGPT/AI to work faster and more effectively

Helping document and improve our business processes

Who We're Looking For



Above everything else, we want someone who is:



Honest • Reliable • Hard-working • Proactive • Intelligent • Diligent • Consistent • Highly organised



You should have excellent written English, be confident using ChatGPT and AI tools, be comfortable learning new technology and ideally have experience with some of the following:



CRM systems • Lead generation • Online research • Social media • Business administration • Customer follow-up



Experience with GoHighLevel and/or property/real estate would be a big advantage, but isn't essential for the right person.



Most importantly, we don't want someone who simply waits to be given their next task.



We want someone who learns how the business works, takes responsibility, follows things through and regularly asks:



"What else can I do to move this forward?"



What's In It For You?



This is intended to be a stable, long-term position, not a short-term freelance project.



You will work directly with an experienced UK business owner and gain exposure to several areas including property investment, AI, automation, CRM, marketing, training and business operations.



As you demonstrate your ability and earn trust, we want you to take increasing ownership and responsibility.



For the right person, there will be opportunities for:



Performance-related bonuses

Increased responsibility

Professional development

Potentially increased hours

Growth into a more senior operational role



We value good people and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us over the long term.



Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week



How to Apply



Please start your application with the words:



AI OPERATIONS



Then briefly answer the following:



Why do you think you would be great for this role?

How do you currently use ChatGPT/AI in your work? Please give examples.

What experience do you have with CRM systems, lead generation and business administration?

Do you have any property/real estate experience?

What is your expected hourly rate in USD?

Why are you looking for a long-term part-time position?



Please don't send us a generic application. We are particularly interested in hearing about real examples of how you have taken initiative, solved problems or improved something without waiting to be told what to do.



If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Social Media & Community Manager

Part time — approx. 20 hrs/week



We're a science-based online wellbeing brand with a nature focus, and we're looking for a part-time Social Media & Community Manager who genuinely gets the personal growth space.



Position Type: Long-Term Part-Time

We're looking for a dedicated, long-term team member who wants stable, consistent work with us as their main priority. This is a long-term role, not a short-term project — we want someone who will integrate into our team, learn our brand, and grow with us over time.



Alignment Check: Part of our messaging draws on how our bodies and minds were shaped over millions of years in the natural world. If this conflicts with your own views then this role isn’t a good fit. 



What you'll be doing - 

Creating and scheduling social media content in our established brand voice

Managing and energising our online community group - sparking conversation, responding warmly, keeping people engaged

Handling comments and DMs across platforms

Producing graphics and short-form video/Reels content

Reporting on what's working and what's not

Proven social media content and community management experience

Strong copywriting skills - you know how to stop a scroll

Social media graphic creation and video/Reels editing

Reads analytics and reports clearly

Fast to respond, proactive, and self-directed - you don't wait to be told

WordPress, CRM and Paid Ads Buyer experience are all a plus, but not essential.



The following points are essential - please only apply if this is you:

In your application, respond to each of the following:



Demonstrate experience building or managing an engaged community - ideally within health, wellness, or a related service space.

Relate your experience with genuine, lived personal growth or depth in the wellbeing space.

Share what nature means to you, personally — if you have depth and awareness here, don't hold back.



Details

Approx. 20 fixed hours/week —  with some flexibility in how we set that up.

Remote — We are based in Australia so it's Philippines timezone (daytime working hours).



To apply

Please send your resume and a link to your portfolio, along with your answers to the three points above.

Rate: Please include your expected rate in your application.

Please write your answers yourself rather than using AI.

title: META MEDIA BUYER ($1,500–$2,000 ) – HIGH-TICKET LEAD GENERATION (FULL TIME)
description:
META MEDIA BUYER — HIGH-TICKET LEAD GENERATION (FULL TIME)

Salary: $1,500–$2,000 USD/month (based on experience + performance bonuses)

Location: Remote

Hours: Minimum 4 hours overlap with US business hours (PST or EST)

Tracking: Time Doctor is required



------------------------------------------------------------



ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing performance marketing and lead generation agency working with premium, high-ticket service brands across the United States.



Our mission is simple: generate high-quality leads and booked appointments that convert into closed deals and long-term revenue for our clients.



We are looking for a highly skilled
 / Meta media buyer who knows how to turn paid traffic into qualified, high-ticket leads and scale campaigns profitably. If you can consistently produce leads that close, we want to speak with you.



We run campaigns across a range of high-ticket verticals (home services, solar, finance, coaching, professional services and similar). Experience in any high-ticket lead generation niche is welcome — solar is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.



------------------------------------------------------------



YOUR ROLE



You will manage and scale Meta advertising campaigns across multiple high-ticket client accounts.



This is not an entry-level media buying role.



We are looking for someone who understands:

• High-ticket lead generation

• Buyer psychology and intent

• Conversion-focused creative testing

• Appointment and lead quality

• Funnel optimisation

• Scaling systems

• KPI accountability



------------------------------------------------------------



CAMPAIGNS YOU'LL MANAGE



Lead Generation & Appointment Funnels

• Consultation & quote-request funnels

• Appointment-booking campaigns

• Application / qualification funnels

• Local and multi-location campaigns



Full Campaign Ownership

You will manage the complete campaign lifecycle: strategy, campaign setup, creative testing, optimisation, scaling, reporting, and performance analysis.



Platforms & Systems

•
 Ads Manager & Business Manager

• GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Calendly, Zapier

• Landing page funnels & CRM automation systems



------------------------------------------------------------



CREATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES



We believe creative is one of the biggest performance levers in paid advertising. You will help develop and optimise:

• Static ads

• Video ads

• UGC-style creatives

• AI-enhanced creatives

• Hook testing frameworks

• Angle testing systems



Tools we use: Canva Pro, CapCut, Premiere Pro, HeyGen, Sora, ElevenLabs, Nano Banana Pro.



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT YOU SHOULD MASTER



The core of this role is generating high-ticket leads that close. You should deeply understand:

• Direct-response strategy and offer positioning

• High-intent audience targeting and testing

• Lead quality vs. lead volume trade-offs

• Multi-step qualification funnels

• Retargeting systems

• Creative fatigue management

• Pixel tracking, CAPI integrations and lead attribution



------------------------------------------------------------



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



We care about results — not vanity metrics. You should be comfortable being accountable to:

• CPL (Cost Per Lead)

• CPA (Cost Per Appointment)

• Appointment / set rates and show rates

• Lead quality and qualification

• Funnel conversion rates

• ROAS and overall acquisition efficiency



Additional KPIs

• Maintain strong CTR performance

• Improve landing page conversion rates

• Reduce lead costs while maintaining quality

• Improve appointment-to-close quality

• Deliver consistent optimisation insights weekly



------------------------------------------------------------



EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS



Required

• 2+ years of
 / Meta Ads experience

• Proven success with high-ticket lead generation

• Experience scaling campaigns while maintaining profitability

• Strong understanding of direct-response marketing

• Ability to analyse performance data and optimise campaigns decisively



Nice to Have

• Local and multi-location lead generation



------------------------------------------------------------



WHAT TO INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION



Your application will not be considered if you do not follow the format below.



Subject line: "Meta Buyer - [Years Experience] - [Highest Monthly Spend] - [Best Cost Per Lead/Appointment]"

PERFORMANCE BONUSES

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

title: META MEDIA BUYER ($1,500–$2,000) – B2B & B2C HIGH-TICKET LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST (FULL TIME)
description:
META MEDIA BUYER – B2B & B2C HIGH-TICKET LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST (FULL TIME)



Solar experience a strong advantage – not a requirement.



Salary: $1,500–$2,000 USD/month (based on experience) + performance bonuses

Location: Remote

Time Zone Overlap: Minimum 4 hours with US (PST or EST) or UK business hours

Tracking Software: Time Doctor is required





ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing AI appointment generation agency. We help our clients turn ad spend into premium leads and sales-qualified appointments – the kind that convert into high-ticket sales, long-term contracts, and lasting customer value.



At our core, we are a high-ticket lead generation agency. We're looking for a skilled Meta Media Buyer with a proven track record of generating qualified B2B leads (and B2C where relevant) through Meta Ads – in any high-intent, consultative, high-ticket vertical.



Solar is one of our largest verticals (UK and USA), so direct solar lead gen experience is a strong advantage. But it is NOT a requirement. What is non-negotiable is proven high-ticket lead gen skill that transfers – work where each lead carries real value, the sales cycle is consultative, and the buyer is qualified before they ever reach sales. If you've consistently driven qualified leads and appointments in high-ticket verticals (B2B services, finance, real estate, healthcare, B2B SaaS, home services, premium consultations, and similar) and can adapt fast, we want to hear from you.





WHAT YOU'LL MANAGE



- Large monthly ad budgets across multiple client accounts

- Full campaign lifecycle: strategy, setup, optimisation, scaling, and reporting

- Advanced audience segmentation and lookalike modelling

- CRM and automation integrations: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Calendly, Zapier



B2B Campaigns (primary focus) – qualified consultations, partnership and channel/dealer recruitment, strategy calls, and high-ticket appointment generation.



B2C Campaigns – consumer consultations, quote and assessment campaigns, financing and rebate offers, and high-intent lead capture.



Our current mix spans high-ticket B2B across several industries, with a strong concentration in solar (commercial and residential solar, battery storage, energy independence, solar financing, dealer recruitment, EPC partnerships). You'll be trained on our offers and qualification processes – what we need from you is proven high-ticket lead gen skill that carries over.





CREATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES



- Develop AI-driven ad creatives using tools such as HeyGen, Sora, ElevenLabs, and Nano Banana Pro

- Produce static and video ads in Canva Pro, Premiere Pro, and CapCut

- Test fresh hooks, angles, and offers tailored to each audience and buyer stage

- Analyse creative performance and iterate quickly

- Maintain brand consistency while scaling creative assets

- Ship fresh creative consistently to stay ahead of ad fatigue



Hooks and angles vary by account, but generally fall into:



B2B / commercial: cost reduction, ROI and long-term savings, tax incentives, sustainability and ESG positioning, operational efficiency

B2C / consumer: bill savings, rising costs, government rebates and tax credits, security and resilience, financing options, long-term value





PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



You'll be measured on qualified leads and appointments – quality first, volume second.



Example targets (solar accounts, for reference only – the same discipline applies across verticals):



- B2B USA: $120–400 CPA depending on market, offer, and qualification criteria

- B2B UK: £80–300 CPA depending on targeting and project size

- B2C: CPA/CPL targets vary by market, offer structure, and qualification process



Core KPIs across all accounts:



- Minimum 2.5% CTR across campaigns

- Strong landing page conversion rates

- Improved booked-appointment show rates

- High lead-to-close quality metrics

- Sales-qualified appointment generation

- Weekly performance reporting with actionable optimisation insights





EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS



Required:



- 2+ years of
/Meta Ads experience

- Proven track record generating qualified B2B leads through Meta Ads (B2C experience a plus)

- Strong command of:

    - B2B lead generation and high-ticket consultation funnels

    - Multi-step qualification processes

    - B2C consumer acquisition funnels

    - Meta audience targeting (LinkedIn targeting a plus)

- Portfolio showing ad spend managed, CPL/CPA results, lead gen metrics, and scaling results

- Proven ability to scale campaigns 3x+ while holding target CPA/CPL

- Experience running local and multi-location campaigns

- Ability to diagnose underperforming campaigns and rapidly turn them around



Strong advantage (not required):



- Proven high-ticket lead gen in any vertical – where each lead is valuable, the sale is consultative, and qualification matters

- Direct solar lead gen experience (commercial, residential, or both)

- UK or US market experience

- Familiarity with high-ticket or solar sales cycles and offer structures





WHAT TO PROVE IN YOUR APPLICATION



- Screenshots of ad account dashboards showing spend and performance

- Specific CPL or CPA improvements you've achieved (with numbers)

- Your best campaign scaling or turnaround story

- Experience managing large monthly budgets

- The industries/verticals you've generated leads in (high-ticket B2B and solar a plus)

- Whether your experience is primarily B2B, B2C, or both



We fully respect NDAs and client confidentiality. We are NOT asking for confidential client information – we're looking for proven ability to deliver results, shown through metrics, tangible proof, or performance breakdowns.





TRAINING & GROWTH PATH



First 30 days – Onboarding into our lead generation systems; understanding offer positioning and qualification processes (including our solar offers).



Months 2–3 – Full account ownership, performance accountability, and scaling of winning campaigns.



Ongoing – Advanced AI creative training, high-ticket lead gen mentorship, and funnel optimisation frameworks.



Performance bonuses are tied to lead quality, appointment show rates, client retention, campaign scalability, and qualified lead generation.





TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



- Advanced
 Business Manager and Ads Manager skills

- Conversion tracking setup and optimisation

- CRM integration experience: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Calendly

- Landing page optimisation knowledge

HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the subject line:



Meta Buyer – [Years Experience] – [Highest Monthly Spend] – [Best Cost Per Appointment]
