title: Lead Intelligence & Business Development VA
description:
Velvet Music is a professional live-music company specializing in weddings, corporate events, galas, private parties, and other special events. We've been operating since 2014 and are building a modern, technology-assisted sales and marketing system to grow the business.



We're looking for a tech-savvy Lead Intelligence & Business Development VA who can help us consistently discover qualified opportunities and referral relationships.



This is not simply a data-entry or list-building position.



We're looking for someone who can research, make calls, use technology, think creatively, and tell us which lead-generation methods are actually worth our time and money.



What You'll Do

1. Find people who are actively looking for our services



You'll research relevant online communities, including
 groups and other social platforms, to identify people who are actively looking for:



Violinists

String ensembles

Jazz musicians

Harpists

Guitarists

Live wedding music

Event entertainment

Ceremony music

Cocktail-hour music

Corporate/event musicians



For example, if someone posts:



"Does anyone know a violinist for my wedding in Miami?"



your job is to identify the opportunity, gather the relevant information, and follow our approved process for responding or routing the lead.



You must understand the difference between a real opportunity and a random post.



You should also follow the rules of each platform/group and avoid spammy or inappropriate automated posting.



2. Research upcoming events



We will provide you with information such as PDFs, event lists, calendars, and other resources.



Your job will be to turn that information into actual business opportunities.



For example:



Upcoming event ? organizer ? venue ? decision-maker ? contact information ? potential need ? CRM



You will research:



Weddings

Corporate events

Galas

Fundraisers

Private events

Real estate events

Concerts

Other events where live music may be appropriate

3. Research venues we've already worked with



We have an existing history of venues where Velvet has performed.



You will:



Research those venues.

Identify the appropriate event/wedding contacts.

Make professional phone calls when appropriate.

Introduce Velvet using an approved script.

Determine whether they have a preferred-vendor program.

Find out how we can become a recommended/preferred music provider.

Identify who makes decisions about entertainment.

Record the information in our CRM.



Strong spoken English is therefore required.

title: Virtual Assistant (experienced)
description:
# Virtual Assistant – Kajabi, Canva & Video Editing



**Part-time | Ongoing | Philippines-based VA**



I'm looking for a smart, reliable and proactive Virtual Assistant to help me build and launch a new online women's health program.



The program is designed to help women improve their C-section scars, and I'm currently in the process of building the program inside Kajabi.



I'm a physiotherapist and the owner of Complete C-Section Recovery, an online business supporting women through C-section recovery. I'm looking for someone who can take the practical, techy parts of building the program off my plate so I can focus on creating the content and supporting my clients.



This is initially a project-based role to help me get the online programbuilt and ready for launch, but **there is potential for this to become an ongoing VA role** as the business grows.



## What you'll be doing



### ???? Video editing



I have already filmed the content for the program, so I need someone who can:



* Edit my raw video footage into clean, professional lesson videos

* Remove mistakes, pauses and unnecessary sections

* Add captions/text overlays where required

* Keep the editing simple, clean and consistent with my brand

* Export videos in the correct format and upload them into Kajabi



You don't need to create complicated cinematic videos — I'm looking for **clean, professional and engaging educational content**.



### ???? Kajabi



You'll help me build out the members' area of the program, including:



* Uploading videos and lesson content

* Adding lesson descriptions and written content

* Organising the members' portal so it is easy for clients to navigate

* Checking that everything works correctly from the customer's perspective

* Making sure the program looks polished and professional before launch



**Previous Kajabi experience is essential.**



### ???? Canva



You'll also create simple, attractive graphics and lesson thumbnails in Canva.



I already have a brand style, colours and fonts, so you won't be starting from scratch. I need someone who can follow an existing visual style consistently and has a good eye for design.



### ????????? Potential ongoing work



Once the program launches, the role may expand to include things such as:



* Customer service and responding to client questions

* Helping clients navigate the program

* Basic Kajabi administration

* Uploading future content

* General VA support for Complete C-Section Recovery



## The person I'm looking for



I'm looking for someone who is:



* **Experienced with Kajabi** — this is essential

* **Very comfortable with Canva**

* Experienced with video editing

* Technologically confident and able to figure things out independently

* Fast and efficient without being careless

* Highly organised and detail-oriented

* A good communicator

* Reliable and able to meet deadlines

* Proactive — you don't need me to explain every tiny step

* Able to follow instructions but also use your own initiative

* Comfortable asking questions when something isn't clear

* Someone who takes pride in producing work that looks polished and professional



I'm not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and completes tasks one by one.



**I need someone who can look at a task, understand what I'm trying to achieve, and work out the best way to get it done.**



Because we're working towards a launch date, being able to work quickly and meet deadlines is important.



You will be working with content relating to C-section recovery, postpartum women and women's health, so you also need to be comfortable working with this type of content.



## About me



I'm Emma, a physiotherapist and mum of four, and I've been running my own businesses for many years.



I'm based in Australia and I'm building Complete C-Section Recovery to help women feel more informed and supported before and after a C-section.



I'm friendly, straightforward and easy to work with, but I do have high standards. I care about the quality of the work I put out into the world, and I want to find someone who feels the same way.



I'm looking for someone who I can build a **long-term working relationship with**, rather than someone who is simply looking for a quick project.



## How to apply



Please don't send a generic application telling me that you are "hardworking, honest and dedicated."



I'd like to see whether you're actually the right person for this role.



Please send me:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and your VA experience.

2. How long you have been working with **Kajabi** and what you've used it for.

3. Your experience with **Canva** and video editing.

4. Examples of previous Kajabi, Canva or video editing work you have completed.

5. Your usual availability and timezone.

6. Your hourly rate.

7. Your
 ID.



**Important:** Please start your application with the words **BETTER SCAR** so I know you've read the entire job post.



I'm looking to hire someone **as soon as possible**, with the initial priority being getting the Better Scar Challenge built and ready for launch.

title: Group Finance & Administration Officer
description:
# Group Finance & Administration Officer



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Engagement: Full-time

Hours: Monday–Friday, aligned to Australian Eastern business hours

Remuneration: 70,000 Peso per month, plus HMO allowance and 13th-month equivalent

Reports to: Executive General Manager



---



## About the role



We are an Australian multi-site services group operating several business units (BUs) across Australia. Each BU is run by its own General Manager, who currently handles that unit's financial administration alongside their operational responsibilities.



This is a newly created role that brings that work into one central function. You will take ownership of customer invoicing, accounts payable, payroll, and Australian compliance lodgements across all BUs — freeing the GMs to focus on operations and customers, and giving the Group one consistent, reliable finance function.



You will work directly with the Executive General Manager, who oversees the GMs and will supervise this role. Lodgements and technical decisions are reviewed by the EGM and the Group's external accountant. You are not working unsupported.



This suits someone who enjoys owning a complete process end to end, is meticulous about deadlines, and wants a stable long-term seat rather than short project work.



---



## What you will do



### Customer invoicing

- Liaise monthly with each BU's General Manager to confirm contract billing, variations and additional works before invoices are issued.

- Prepare and issue monthly customer invoices across all BUs, accurately and on time.

- Maintain each BU's sales and billing register in Xero.



### Accounts payable

- Own end-to-end AP processing for all BUs: supplier bills, coding, approvals and queries.

- Manage supplier payment runs and reconciliations across the Group.



### Payroll

- Process fortnightly payroll for all Australian employees across all BUs, including new starters, terminations and leave.

- Apply Australian award and agreement pay rates as configured, and escalate anything unusual or unclear rather than interpreting it yourself.

- Maintain employee payroll records and respond to pay queries.



### Compliance and lodgements

- Process superannuation guarantee payments, meeting SG due dates.

- Prepare Business Activity Statements for each BU on the applicable cycle, for EGM review before lodgement.

- Prepare payroll tax returns for each applicable BU via the relevant state revenue office portal (for example, PTX Express in Victoria), and monitor Group wages against payroll tax thresholds.

- Prepare workpapers and supporting schedules for annual income tax returns, working with the Group's external accountant and tax agent, who prepare and lodge the returns.

- Maintain a compliance calendar so no lodgement date is missed.



### Finance enquiries

- Act as the Group's central inbound finance contact, by
 only — invoicing queries, account balances, payment terms, credit notes and similar.

- Resolve what you can directly; escalate account-relationship matters to the relevant GM, who retains responsibility for customer phone contact.



### Reporting and set-up

- Deliver monthly P&L reporting at BU and consolidated Group level.

- Support budgeting, variance analysis and ad hoc reporting for the EGM.

- In your first months, work with the EGM to standardise the chart of accounts and coding rules across all BUs so consolidated reporting becomes reliable and repeatable.



---



## What we are looking for



**Essential**

- 3+ years' bookkeeping or accounting experience supporting Australian businesses or accounting firms.

- Hands-on Xero experience, including payroll and multi-entity files.

- Working knowledge of Australian GST and BAS preparation, Single Touch Payroll, and superannuation guarantee obligations.

- Strong written English — most of this role is conducted in writing.

- Genuine attention to detail and a track record of hitting fixed deadlines without being chased.

- Reliable home internet and a quiet, private workspace, given the confidential payroll data involved.



**Well regarded**

- CPA (Philippines) or equivalent qualification.

- Australian payroll tax and multi-state lodgement experience.

- Experience setting up or standardising a chart of accounts across multiple entities.

- Exposure to award-based payroll environments.



---



## What we offer



- A stable, long-term role with a single employer, not agency or shared-seat work.

- Monthly salary of 70,000 Peso, plus a 3,500 monthly HMO allowance — enough to cover you and one dependent — and a 13th-month equivalent.

- Direct working relationship with the Executive General Manager, and full ownership of the function.

- Australian business hours — no night shift.



---



## How to apply



Send your CV and a short note covering:

1. The Australian clients or entities you have worked on, and what you handled for them.

2. Your experience with Xero payroll and BAS preparation.

3. Your monthly rate expectation in PHP.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a paid practical assessment: a month-end reconciliation and a BAS preparation from sample data.

title: DR Copywriter / Creative Strategist
description:
DR Copywriter / Creative Strategist



Location: Remote (Global – Asia or Europe strongly preferred)

Employment Type: Full-Time

On Target Earnings (OTE):  ($2,000++ per month + uncapped 2% performance bonus on ad spend)



This role is for one very specific type of person. If you are not this person, do not apply. You will waste your time and ours.



???? This is for you if:

You are genuinely obsessed with marketing and cannot stop analyzing ads, hooks, copy, and human buying psychology.

You are an operator, not a manager. You write the copy. You build the briefs. You personally execute.

You work the hours the work demands, not because someone is watching, but because you are driven to win.

You are motivated by money and ready to earn $$$ by delivering clear, measurable results.

You are open to occasional travel — a couple of times a year for in person training workshops

You are highly resourceful, figure things out on your own, and hate hand-holding.



???? This is NOT for you if:

You want a comfortable 30-40 hour work week, predictable days, and to clock out at 5 PM.

You want to "oversee" people, delegate tasks, and avoid getting your hands dirty.

You come from a big corporate background where you managed agencies but didn't write the copy or build the ads yourself.

You need a checklist or a manager to tell you what to do every single morning.

You care more about fancy titles, perks, or "corporate culture" than raw performance and uncapped financial upside.



If any of those red flags describe you, close this page right now.



???? About Us & Company Background

We are a fast-growing, performance-first DTC brand building the next major name in emotional gifting. We create message-card jewelry that helps people express what they often struggle to put into words, turning meaningful relationships into gifts that are deeply personal, memorable, and wearable.



After generating approximately €6 million in revenue in 2025, including €4 million in Q4, we are now expanding across Europe and aggressively entering the U.S. market. Our goal is to scale Custom Love toward $30 million in revenue over the next 12 months and establish the brand as a global leader in emotional gifting.



We already have validated product-market fit, proven winning products, substantial advertising capital, an experienced team, and an internal creative-production engine. The foundation is built. Now we are looking for a world-class creative operator who can uncover powerful customer insights, develop winning concepts consistently, and help turn our growth engine into something truly massive.



???? Our Bottleneck & Your Mission

Right now, we are the core bottleneck on creative strategy, ad ideation, copywriting, and product launches, all of which drive our growth engine. Because our business scales entirely on Meta ads, our creative output is currently capped by our own time and bandwidth.



As our DR Copywriter / Creative Strategist, your mission is to completely take ad ideation, copywriting, and performance execution off our plates. You will unlock massive ad volume, scale product launches, and pioneer creative experimentation to push our account to the next level.





???? Scope of Work (What You Will Do)

This is an execution-heavy role with high-level creative autonomy. You will start by plugging into our highly profitable, proven frameworks, and quickly scale up to completely running the show.



Daily Responsibilities:



Ad Ideation & Copywriting: Write high-converting hooks, scripts, product description cards, and angles from scratch.

Creative Briefing: Build sharp, objective creative briefs for our editing team—directing scenarios, visual cues, and performance pacing.

Data Review: Analyze Meta Ads Manager and creative reporting tools (like Atria) daily to spot winners, diagnose losers, and determine what to test next.



What You Own vs. What You Don't:

You Fully Own: Ad concepts, direct response copywriting, brief creation, scenario direction, and tactical testing decisions.

You Do NOT Do Video editing and post-production , creator sourcing and management, media buying execution, and top-level company strategy





???? Experience & Skill Signals



Your Background Likely Looks Like One of These:



The Scrappy In-House Creative Strategist: You are driving massive scale at a smaller DTC brand right now, writing winning hooks weekly, but you are hitting a professional or financial ceiling.



The Media Buyer Turned Creative: You got tired of just clicking buttons in Ads Manager and started making the ads themselves because your creative ideas were stronger than the actual creative team's.



The Video Editor Turned Creative Strategist: You started by executing other people’s briefs, but soon realized you understood hooks, pacing, storytelling, and buyer psychology better than the strategists directing you. Now you’re ready to own the ideas, not just edit them.



The Copywriter Turned Creative Strategist: You started by writing the words, but quickly realized your strongest skill was finding the angles, hooks, and big ideas behind winning ads. Now you want to own the entire creative strategy, not just the copy.





Portfolio Non-Negotiables:

You must be able to share specific ads you personally created, alongside their concrete business results, and explain the explicit direct response logic behind why they worked or failed. If you cannot point to an ad and say "I made this, here was my hypothesis, and here is what happened," you are not a fit.





? Technical & Operating Style

Must-Know Tools: Meta Ads Manager, Creative Analytics Platforms (Atria or equivalent), and spreadsheet-based ad reporting.

Pace: Rapid, intense, high-output startup environment.

Communication Cadence: Same-day response cadence, 6 days a week. We move at lightning speed, use a scrappy, zero-fluff communication style, and text on weekends.

Thick Skin: You must welcome harsh, hyper-direct criticism without ego or defensiveness. We care entirely about winning and outcomes, not appearances or hurt feelings.





???? Compensation, Incentives & Upside



Base Salary: $2,000++ per month (banded based on experience and past track record).

Performance Bonus: 2% of total ad spend on every single ad you create.





???? HOW TO APPLY

If you read this entire document and your immediate reaction is "This is exactly how I operate," apply now and submit this form:

title: AI Savvy Executive Assistant
description:
A Role Built for What's Next

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant role.

At Atlas Assistants, we are redefining what it means to support at the highest level. The executives we work with don't just want someone to manage their inbox and calendar. They want someone who treats AI as a craft, building automations, designing workflows, creating custom tools, and turning hours of manual work into systems that run themselves.

This is still an EA role at its core. You'll own calendars, inboxes, travel, and the thousand details that keep an executive's world running. But you'll do it as someone who uses AI tools as a force multiplier, delivering smarter, faster, more effective outcomes every day.

If you naturally look for better ways of doing things, question inefficiencies, and enjoy making complicated things simple, this role is a good fit.



About Atlas Assistants

At Atlas Assistants, we're more than a service provider. We're a community dedicated to empowering both entrepreneurs and executive assistants to reach their fullest potential.

Our mission is twofold: alleviate the operational burdens our clients face so they can focus on strategic growth and personal fulfilment, and create an environment where EAs thrive, grow, and build genuinely rewarding careers.

What sets us apart:

Supportive culture — a nurturing environment where team members uplift each other

High-performance mindset — a shared commitment to excellence and pushing boundaries daily

Growth-focused — serious investment in your personal and professional development

Values-driven — our core values guide every decision we make

Accountability — mutual responsibility that builds real trust

Diversity and inclusion — over 80% of our team are women, spanning nearly 20 countries

Our EAs operate inside the Atlas Executive Management System (EMS), the proven playbook that has helped over 100 clients achieve their goals.

You won't just work here. You'll grow here.



What Makes This Role Different

Most Executive Assistant roles focus on managing tasks. This one focuses on improving how those tasks exist in the first place.

Client expectations have shifted. Our clients want EAs who don't just use AI tools, but build with them, automating inboxes, designing workflows, creating custom agents, and turning hours of manual work into systems that run themselves.

That means this role goes beyond execution. It's about ownership, optimization, and building systems that scale.

Top performers in this role don't wait for instructions. They:

Anticipate needs before they surface

Introduce better ways of working

Build and refine automations that remove recurring manual effort

Continuously improve the systems they own

Deliver more value over time, not just more hours

If that sounds familiar, keep reading.



A Day in the Life

Here's what your day might actually look like:

Morning: The agent skill you built has already triaged overnight
s. You review, adjust, and send. Your executive starts their day without inbox anxiety.

Mid-morning: A calendar conflict cascades into three rescheduling chains. You fix it, send your executive a quick Loom summary, and move on before they've noticed.

Late morning: Your executive mentions expense reports are eating their time. You map the workflow, spin up a an automation that pulls receipts from Gmail and categorises them with AI, and ship it before lunch.

Afternoon: Investor prep session. You use AI agent or automation you built to research and pull together a one-pager, walk them through it, and help them walk in confident.

Later: You check the monitoring agent you set up for press mentions, draft a response to a flagged article, and add one more workflow to your backlog.

You consistently deliver more than a traditional EA because you're building AI systems, not just completing tasks.



What You'll Own

Calendar & Inbox Management Manage complex schedules, protect your executive's time, and handle all correspondence, using AI to triage, draft, and organize so that everything is handled before they ask.

Communication & Stakeholder Management Represent your executive with professionalism and discretion. Draft in their voice, manage stakeholder relationships with emotional intelligence, and use AI to maintain quality and consistency at speed.

Project & Travel Coordination End-to-end execution: coordination, follow-ups, logistics, and accountability tracking. Build AI systems that give your executive full visibility without them having to chase anything.

Decision Support Prepare summaries, briefing documents, and structured research. Don't just gather information. Synthesize it into something your executive can act on, and use AI to do in an hour what used to take a day.

AI-Powered Execution Spot inefficient workflows and automate them. Build agents, automations, and AI-assisted tools that reduce manual effort and improve consistency. Monitor what you've deployed, iterate, and keep improving over time.

Personal Support Gifts, reservations, errands, and life administration, keeping your executive focused on the work that only they can do.



Ideal Candidate Profile

You are:

Highly organized, proactive, and resourceful. You stay ahead of what's needed.

A strong communicator with sound judgement and a high degree of discretion

Comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments with minimal hand-holding

Naturally inclined to optimize, automate, and improve. When you see a better way, you build it.

Passionate and hands-on with AI tools and new technology. Not just aware of it, but actively using and building with it.

Someone who takes full ownership and follows through without being chased



Minimum Requirements

EA Foundation

At least 2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting senior leaders

Near-native written and spoken English

Remote work experience preferred

Available to work US time zones

AI Capability (Non-Negotiable) Demonstrated, hands-on experience using AI tools in practice. You should be able to point to concrete examples of:

Workflow automations you've built using tools like Zapier, Make, or n8n

Custom GPTs, AI agents, or skills you've created and actively use

Deeper work with AI platforms like Claude or ChatGPT: structured, multi-step prompting, not just conversation

Measurable improvements you've delivered for an executive or team using AI

"I use AI daily" won't move your application forward. Be ready to describe specific things you've built: what the problem was, what you created, and what changed.



Benefits & Growth

Salary starting from ~$1,600 USD/month (40 hrs/week), with growth potential tied to performance and impact

Fully remote, work from anywhere

Time off: 10 paid days, unlimited sick leave, 7 holidays

Development: access to Atlas EMS training, ongoing AI and automations training, group coaching calls and office hours

Community: access to a global network of EAs and leaders

Stability: we prioritize finding new opportunities for high performers within our network

There's room to grow here. We reward people who bring more to the table.



Who This Is For

This role is for people who want to operate at a higher level.

If you're looking for a standard EA position, this isn't it. But if you're ready to build smarter systems, work with high-level executives, and grow your career in a direction that keeps pace with where work is going, we'd love to meet you.



How to Apply

title: Real Estate Closing Coordinator (U.S. Residential)
description:
About AIK Property Group



AIK Property Group is a residential real estate development company based in New York. We acquire, renovate, and sell homes while working closely with buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, title companies, municipalities, nonprofit organizations, and housing grant agencies.



We're looking for an experienced Real Estate Closing Coordinator who can take ownership of the transaction process and ensure every deal moves efficiently from contract execution to a successful closing.



This is not an entry-level position. We're seeking someone who already understands U.S. residential real estate transactions and can demonstrate that experience.



---



Your Mission



Your job is simple:



Keep every transaction moving toward closing.



You'll be responsible for coordinating multiple active transactions, anticipating issues before they become delays, following up relentlessly, and ensuring every party involved remains accountable.



You should always know:



* Which transactions are on track.

* Which transactions are at risk.

* What documents or approvals are outstanding.

* Who is responsible for the next action.

* What needs to happen today to move every file forward.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership—not someone who waits for instructions.



---



Key Responsibilities



* Coordinate residential real estate transactions from executed contract through closing.

* Manage multiple active transactions while maintaining accuracy and organization.

* Maintain transaction timelines and monitor all critical deadlines.

* Coordinate with buyers, sellers, lenders, attorneys, title companies, municipalities, contractors, grant administrators, and internal team members.

* Collect, organize, review, and track all required transaction documentation.

* Proactively identify and resolve issues that could delay closing.

* Maintain complete and organized transaction records.

* Provide accurate and timely updates on every active transaction.

* Ensure every transaction continues progressing until funding and closing are complete.



---



# What We're Looking For



The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of:



* U.S. residential real estate transactions

* Contract-to-close coordination

* Title and attorney coordination

* Lender communication and requirements

* Closing timelines and deadlines

* Document collection and compliance

* Managing multiple transactions simultaneously



You should also be comfortable learning and working within AIK Property Group's systems, including the **Greater Capital Association of REALTORS® (GCAR)** platform and other transaction management tools used by our team.



---



# Minimum Qualifications



* Minimum **3 years of experience** coordinating U.S. residential real estate transactions.

* Proven ability to successfully manage multiple active transactions simultaneously.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

* Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving abilities.

* Highly dependable, responsive, and detail-oriented.

* Able to work independently with minimal supervision.



---



# Application Requirements



We value demonstrated experience over résumé claims.



To be considered, your application must include all of the following:



* Updated résumé.

* Brief cover letter summarizing your real estate closing experience.

* Supporting evidence that demonstrates your transaction coordination experience.



Examples of acceptable supporting evidence include:



* Redacted closing checklists you managed.

* Sample transaction timelines.

* Screenshots of transaction pipelines or dashboards (with confidential information removed).

* Process documentation you created or maintained.

* Other work samples that clearly demonstrate your role in coordinating residential real estate closings.



Please remove or redact all confidential client information before submitting any documentation.



Applications submitted without supporting evidence will not be reviewed.



---



# Interview Process



Qualified applicants will be invited to participate in a Transaction Case Review



During this session, you will be asked to share your screen and walk us through a completed transaction that you coordinated (using a redacted file or recreated workflow if necessary).



You should be prepared to explain:



* How the transaction progressed from contract to closing.

* The major milestones and deadlines.

* Challenges encountered during the process.

* How those challenges were resolved.

* How you kept all parties accountable.

* How you organize and prioritize multiple active transactions.



This is not intended to test memorization. We want to understand how you think, communicate, solve problems, and manage real-world transactions.



---



# What Success Looks Like



A successful Closing Coordinator:



* Keeps transactions moving without constant supervision.

* Anticipates issues before they become closing delays.

* Maintains proactive communication with every stakeholder.

* Keeps organized and accurate transaction files.

* Meets deadlines consistently.

* Takes ownership of every transaction from contract to closing.



When someone asks about the status of a file, you already know the answer.



---



# Who Will Thrive in This Role



You'll be a great fit if you are:



* Proactive.

* Organized.

* Reliable.

* Detail-oriented.

* Accountable.

* Calm under pressure.

* Comfortable making decisions and taking ownership.

* Committed to delivering successful closings—not simply completing assigned tasks.



---



# How to Apply



Please
 your application to:







**Required
 Subject Format**



**Closing Coordinator – F. LAST NAME**



**Example:** `Closing Coordinator – J. DELA CRUZ`



Applications that do not follow the required subject format or do not include the requested supporting documentation may not be considered.



---



Our Hiring Philosophy



At AIK Property Group, we hire based on capability, ownership, reliability, and demonstrated experience—not résumé claims alone.



If you're someone who takes pride in keeping transactions organized, solving problems before they become obstacles, and ensuring every closing reaches the finish line, we'd love to hear from you.

title: RIGHT-HAND ASSISTANT - E-COMMERCE, SOCIAL & AI WORKFLOWS (FULL-TIME, LONG-TERM)
description:
Read this before applying - it will save us both time.



We're not hiring a virtual assistant who works from a task list. We're hiring one person we can hand an OUTCOME to - "keep the Etsy shops selling," "get our music app in front of more families" - who then goes and makes it happen. If you are not proactive, eager to learn and a go-getter please do not apply.



Most of this job is figuring out the how. We'll tell you what needs to be true; we don't always tell you the steps, because we expect you to be proactive and take more off our plate. If that sounds energizing, read on. If it sounds stressful, this genuinely isn't the right role and we'd rather you skip it.



ABOUT US



MMC Media is a small US-based company - the owner plus five people. We run three things:



- A family-safe music streaming app. 5,000+ original songs across 22 genres: pop, rock, country, hip-hop, R&B, electronic, folk, indie and more. Built for parents who want their kids listening to real, current-sounding music without explicit content. It's a mainstream catalog - pop-forward, not a religious app. (We'll tell you the name when we talk.)



- Etsy shops. Digital printables and downloads. Needs attention every single day (about 1 hour).



- Social and content. Several accounts across Pinterest, TikTok, Instagram,
 and YouTube for our blogs.



Honest about our stage: the app is live with real users but early on revenue. You'd be joining to help build something, not to maintain a machine that already runs. Systems are half-built, some things are messy, and you'll often be the first person to do a given task. If you want a large, stable, fully-documented company, you'd be unhappy here. Our other businesses are stable and have more consistent processes and revenue.



WHAT YOU'D OWN



App growth (primary)

- Social content: planning, scheduling and publishing across our accounts - then reading what actually worked and changing the plan because of it.

- Customer support for app users - fast responses, spotting recurring complaints, telling us what you're seeing.

- Launch and campaign support: getting things out the door on time.



Etsy shops (live revenue - this can't slip)

- Customer messages answered every day, without exception.

- Promotions and sales running continuously.

- Listing SEO, publishing new products, watching which listings earn and which don't.

- Keyword research to help us find new listing.

- Using our AI processes to help create new products and listings



AI-driven operations

- Use AI daily - and improve how the work gets done, not just do it faster.

- Bring us new tools and workflows. Part of this job is staying current and telling US what changed.



Reporting

- One brief written report of what you accomplished that day.



Later - not at the start

- This role has the potential to grow into coordinating one or two other people as we grow. That's the direction, not your first-months job, and we won't pretend otherwise. You should have leadership skills as we hope this role will grow into something more.



THE DETAILS



- Full-time, 40 hours/week, long-term.

- Starting at $500/month. Raises here come from results, not from time served - people who deliver have earned multiple increases. If you're asking for more than $500, apply anyway and tell us your number and why. We'd rather talk about it than miss the right person over a starting figure.



- Based in the Philippines, with flexibility to overlap U.S. Mountain Time occasionally for a call.

- We use TeamLogger for time tracking.

- Flexible schedule - days, nights, spread out, weekends. As long as you are consistently working throughout the week and turning in meaningful work.

- PTO after 6 months full-time.

- Paid time to learn. Training happens on the clock.



WHAT WE'RE LIKE TO WORK FOR



- We train people properly and pay for the time it takes.

- We give direct, specific feedback - you'll always know where you stand.

- We're accommodating with real life when you communicate with us. We've carried people through hard stretches. What we can't work with is disappearing.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through the form here:



Please don't send a separate cover letter - we won't read one. The form is what we read.



A couple of the questions ask you to go look at something before you answer them. Please actually do that part. Those answers matter far more to us than a polished resume, and they're what we read first.



What happens after you apply:



1. We read every application.

2. Shortlisted candidates send us a short recorded intro (about 2 minutes) or hop on a quick call - we want to hear how you explain things, since this role involves calls.

3. Finalists do a paid test project - real work, paid at your rate. That's where we both find out whether this fits.



We know applying takes real time. We'll get back to you either way.

I create long-form YouTube commentary videos about pop culture, internet culture, feminism, media, relationships, politics, and social issues.



Most finished videos are approximately **20–25 minutes long**.



My editing style is fairly simple and intentional. Most of the video is me speaking directly to camera. I do not want constant B-roll, flashy effects, excessive transitions, or an overly edited YouTube style.



I want someone with a good eye who can take a simple video and make it feel polished, professional, and visually interesting without making it feel busy.



Important: I Will Provide the Rough Cut



I am **not** asking you to take an hour of raw footage and build the video from scratch.



Before I send the project to you, I will:



* remove mistakes and unusable footage

* remove any private footage

* choose the takes I want

* establish the structure and spoken pacing

* create the basic rough cut



You will receive a mostly completed **CapCut project** that needs its finishing pass.



What I Need From You



For a typical video, I would like you to:



* polish the existing rough cut

* smooth out any awkward remaining edits

* use subtle punch-ins, crops, or reframing when helpful

* add relevant screenshots, images, headlines, clips, or other visual assets

* place any assets or clips I specifically provide

* make simple visual choices when the talking-head footage needs variety

* clean up and balance audio as needed

* make basic color/exposure adjustments as needed

* use simple transitions only when they improve the video

* catch small editing issues I may have missed

* deliver a clean, publish-ready final video



I care much more about **good judgment and restraint** than complicated effects.



If a video works better with me simply talking for 30 seconds, I want an editor who is comfortable leaving me on screen for 30 seconds.



If a screenshot would genuinely make a joke or point land better, I want someone who notices that too.



What I Am NOT Looking For



I am not looking for:



* heavy motion graphics

* constant animated captions

* nonstop B-roll

* MrBeast-style editing

* complicated VFX

* thumbnail design

* Shorts/Reels editing as part of the standard rate - but may become an additional gig opportunity.

* someone to completely restructure or rewrite my videos

* someone to research and source dozens of clips



Additional work can always be discussed separately if a particular video needs something unusual.



Software



I am a tired and busy mom, so I edit in **CapCut Desktop** because it is easy, so a strong CapCut experience is required.



Ideally, we will work through a shared CapCut project so I can create the rough cut, hand the project over to you for polishing, and receive the finished project back.



Pay



**Starting rate: $60 USD per standard video**



A standard video is:



* approximately 20–25 finished minutes

* rough cut already completed by me

* normal visual polishing

* a modest number of visual assets

* one round of reasonable revisions



This is a fixed project rate, not hourly work.



If a future video requires significantly more work than normal, we will agree on a different rate **before** you begin. I do not expect additional work without additional pay.



There are no guaranteed weekly hours or guaranteed number of videos. My goal, however, is to find one editor I enjoy working with and build a long-term working relationship as my channel grows.



Paid Test Edit



I plan to choose a few strong applicants for a **paid test edit of approximately 4–5 minutes** before choosing my ongoing editor.



The test is paid. I do not ask applicants to complete free work.



Who I Think Will Be a Great Fit



You may be a great fit if you:



* have experience editing long-form talking-head or commentary YouTube videos

* are very comfortable in CapCut

* have strong attention to detail

* understand pacing without needing a visual change every few seconds

* have good visual judgment

* can follow an established style rather than forcing your own style onto every project

* communicate clearly

* meet agreed deadlines

* are comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions

* can work independently once you understand what I like

* are comfortable editing progressive content that may discuss feminism, LGBTQ+ issues, religion, politics, misogyny, and other social topics



You do not need to personally agree with every opinion I express, but you do need to be comfortable working with this subject matter respectfully.



To Apply



Please send me:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Your experience editing long-form YouTube videos.

3. Your experience using CapCut Desktop.

4. **2–3 examples of long-form videos you personally edited.** Talking-head, commentary, podcast, educational, or video-essay examples are especially helpful.

5. Tell me what parts of the editing process you handled in those examples.

6. Confirm that you are comfortable with a project-based rate of $60 for a standard 20–25 minute video where the rough cut is already completed.

7. Tell me your usual turnaround time for a project like this.



Please do not send me 20 portfolio links. I would much rather see the **2–3 examples that best show what you can do with the kind of content I described.**



I’m hoping to find someone whose editing makes me say, “Yes. That still feels like my video, I just didn’t have to spend another six hours making it pretty.”
